steps.full_en: Talk to Kain Himere (airplane 50 61) on the Airship to Einbroch . (He's on the lower deck near the gambling tables). Talk to him 3x until he starts crying. Then choose "What's wrong?" and "I have time for a long story." He will tell you a story about his daughter that was lost, then give you a package to deliver to Defra at the Einbroch Hotel.
steps.full_ru: На Airship в Einbroch, под палубой у игровых столов, найдите Kain Himere (airplane 50 61). Поговорите 3x, пока он не заплачет. Выберите «What's wrong?» и «I have time for a long story.». После истории о пропавшей дочери получите package для Defra в Einbroch Hotel.

steps.full_en: Go to the Einbroch Hotel (252 200) and talk to the front desk NPC. He will tell you that Defra is in Room #201. Go upstairs and into the upper left portal. There will be a little girl named Elle next to the correct portal. When you walk near her she will sing a song. Talk to her and choose "what are you singing?". She'll tell you to visit her mother Tarsha Cherno in a house behind the hotel.

steps.full_en: Walk outside behind to hotel to the northeast (einbroch 276 233) and enter the house there. Talk to Tarsha Cherno and her husband. They will tell you to look around the house. Look beside Tarsha for "Unidentified Machine" and "Mirror". When you look at the Mirror, you will see reflected a scar on Tarsha. Talk to her and ask her about the scar and follow the story about her father being lost.

steps.short_ru: У Tarsha Cherno (einbroch 276 233) осмотрите Unidentified Machine и Mirror, спросите о шраме.

steps.full_en: Go back to the airship and talk to Kain. He will take back the package since it was undeliverable, then choose "mention Miner's Song." He will go through a story and ask you to find a Journal to prove that he's Tarsha's father.

steps.full_en: Take that item back to the castle, and talk to the Lord of Palace again. He'll thank you for your work, and give you a Feudal Lord Permit to the dungeon. The dungeon is located on the 5th floor. Simply walk up the ladder you see as you enter the 4th floor, and speak to the NPC waiting there, and he'll let you in. | Note : Do NOT try to use another character's Feudal Lord Permit to access the dungeon before or after doing the quest for yourself. The guard at the dungeon entrance will realize that you are using a permit other than your own and take it. It doesn't matter if you borrow a friend's permit or put one of your alternate character's permits into storage--the guard will take it regardless. This will leave you and the other character permitless.
steps.full_ru: Отнесите этот предмет обратно в замок и снова поговорите с Lord of Palace. Он поблагодарит вас и выдаст Feudal Lord Permit для подземелья. Подземелье находится на 5-м этаже: поднимитесь по лестнице, видимой при входе на 4-й этаж, и поговорите с ожидающим NPC. Примечание: НЕ используйте Feudal Lord Permit другого персонажа ни до, ни после собственного прохождения. Стражник распознаёт чужой пропуск и забирает его, даже если он взят у друга или передан через хранилище с другого вашего персонажа. В результате оба персонажа останутся без пропуска.
steps.original_instruction: Take that item back to the castle, and talk to the Lord of Palace again. He'll thank you for your work, and give you a Feudal Lord Permit to the dungeon. The guard at the dungeon entrance will realize that you are using a permit other than your own and take it. It doesn't matter if you borrow a friend's permit or put one of your alternate character's permits into storage--the guard will take it regardless. This will leave you and the other character permitless.
steps.short_en: Return to Lord of Palace with Nine Tails; use only your own Feudal Lord Permit.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Lord of Palace с Nine Tails; используйте только собственный Feudal Lord Permit.

steps.full_ru: Rumis уже узнал об успехе и хочет сделать собственное открытие. Он попросит встретить его в конце восточного моста и сопроводить для изучения нового вида.
steps.original_instruction: Rumis has already heard, and strives to make his own discovery. Rumis asks you to meet him at the end of the east bridge to escort him to study a one of the new species.
steps.short_en: Get the east-bridge meeting assignment from Rumis.
steps.short_ru: Получите у Rumis задание встретиться у восточного моста.

steps.full_en: Walk past ( man_fild01 55, 259), and Rumis tells you to head towards the tree slightly southeast.
steps.full_ru: Пройдите мимо (man_fild01 55, 259). Rumis предложит направиться к дереву немного юго-восточнее.
steps.original_instruction: Walk past ( man_fild01 55, 259), and Rumis tells you to head towards the tree slightly southeast.
steps.short_en: Trigger the meeting with Rumis: man_fild01 55, 259.
steps.short_ru: Активируйте встречу с Rumis: man_fild01 55, 259.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Frozen Tree ( man_fild01 92, 229), Rumis climbed the tree because monsters were looking at him. He asks you to hunt 20 Horn of Hillslion .
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Frozen Tree (man_fild01 92, 229). Rumis забрался на дерево, потому что монстры смотрели на него. Он попросит добыть 20 Horn of Hillslion.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Frozen Tree ( man_fild01 92, 229), Rumis climbed the tree because monsters were looking at him. He asks you to hunt 20 Horn of Hillslion .
steps.short_en: At Frozen Tree (man_fild01 92, 229), get the task to collect 20 Horn of Hillslion.
steps.short_ru: У Frozen Tree (man_fild01 92, 229) получите задание добыть 20 Horn of Hillslion.

steps.full_en: Return to the tree with 20 horn. Rumis sees nothing particularly interesting about them, but he has gained the confidence to come to his tree alone next time. He asks you to talk to him back at the camp.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к дереву с 20 рогами. Rumis не найдёт в них ничего особенного, но осмелеет и сможет приходить сюда один. Он попросит поговорить с ним обратно в лагере.
steps.original_instruction: Return to the tree with 20 horn. Rumis sees nothing particularly interesting about them, but he has gained the confidence to come to his tree alone next time. He asks you to talk to him back at the camp.
steps.short_en: Take 20 Horn of Hillslion to Frozen Tree, then return to Rumis at camp.
steps.short_ru: Отнесите 20 Horn of Hillslion к Frozen Tree, затем вернитесь к Rumis в лагерь.

steps.full_en: Lumis heard about someone being attacked to the east, he asks you to go investigate if the natives are hostile. Kill 10 Tatacho .
steps.full_ru: Lumis услышал о нападении к востоку и попросит проверить, враждебны ли местные жители. Убейте 10 Tatacho.
steps.original_instruction: Lumis heard about someone being attacked to the east, he asks you to go investigate if the natives are hostile. Kill 10 Tatacho .
steps.short_en: Kill 10 Tatacho for Lumis.
steps.short_ru: По поручению Lumis убейте 10 Tatacho.

steps.full_en: Return to Rumis, he thanks your for your help. This marks the end of the displayed quests, and you gain 1,500,000 Base EXP .
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Rumis. Он поблагодарит за помощь: отображаемые задания завершатся, и вы получите 1,500,000 Base EXP.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Rumis, he thanks your for your help. This marks the end of the displayed quests, and you gain 1,500,000 Base EXP .
steps.short_en: Return to Rumis for 1,500,000 Base EXP.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Rumis за 1,500,000 Base EXP.

steps.full_en: Additionally if you bring Rumis one Horn of Tendrilion you will gain 1,000,000 more Base EXP . This marks the end of this quest. Note : This last step needs to be completed if you are using this quest as one of your pre-requisites to Report from the New World .
steps.full_ru: Дополнительно принесите Rumis один Horn of Tendrilion, чтобы получить ещё 1,000,000 Base EXP. Это завершает квест. Примечание: последний этап обязателен, если вы используете этот квест как одно из предварительных условий для Report from the New World.
steps.original_instruction: Additionally if you bring Rumis one Horn of Tendrilion you will gain 1,000,000 more Base EXP . This marks the end of this quest. Note : This last step needs to be completed if you are using this quest as one of your pre-requisites to Report from the New World .

routes.condition_text: Additional to the displayed tasks and 1500000 EXP, but required when counting this quest as a Report from the New World prerequisite.

steps.short_en: Additionally give Rumis 1 Horn of Tendrilion for 1,000,000 Base EXP; this is needed for Report from the New World.
steps.short_ru: Дополнительно передайте Rumis 1 Horn of Tendrilion за 1,000,000 Base EXP; это нужно для Report from the New World.

step_items.condition_text: Additional reward stage; required if using Attitude as a prerequisite for Report from the New World.

dialogue_options.exact_text: Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers.

rewards.condition_text: Intermediate item after bringing the materials from step 7.
Intermediate access item; level 1.
Dungeon level 2 after obtaining Holier Threads.

steps.full_en: In Ayothaya , find Dusit, he can be found at (82, 132) the far left beach area. He'll talk about a tiger and say "Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers." He will then tell you to go to Boonthon.
steps.full_ru: В Ayothaya найдите Dusit на пляже в дальней левой части города (82, 132). Он расскажет о тигре; ответьте «Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers.». Затем он направит вас к Boonthon.
steps.original_instruction: In Ayothaya , find Dusit, he can be found at (82, 132) the far left beach area. He'll talk about a tiger and say "Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers." He will then tell you to go to Boonthon.
steps.short_en: Talk to Dusit in Ayothaya (82, 132): “Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers.”.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Dusit в Ayothaya (82, 132): «Yes, you believe in man-eating tigers.».

steps.full_en: Boonthon can be found inside the house at (65, 104). Just go south from Dustit and loop around to the left and up along the wooden walkways. She'll ask you for items to make a holy thread after you talk to her telling her you want to find the tiger. | 1 Solid Husk | 1 Holy Water | 1 Needle Packet | 1 Spool
steps.full_ru: Boonthon находится в доме (65, 104). От Dustit идите на юг, затем по деревянным дорожкам налево и вверх. Скажите ей, что хотите найти тигра: она попросит материалы для священной нити — 1 Solid Husk, 1 Holy Water, 1 Needle Packet и 1 Spool.
steps.original_instruction: Boonthon can be found inside the house at (65, 104). Just go south from Dustit and loop around to the left and up along the wooden walkways. She'll ask you for items to make a holy thread after you talk to her telling her you want to find the tiger. | 1 Solid Husk | 1 Holy Water | 1 Needle Packet | 1 Spool
steps.short_en: Talk to Boonthon (65, 104); prepare 1 Solid Husk, 1 Holy Water, 1 Needle Packet, 1 Spool.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Boonthon (65, 104); подготовьте 1 Solid Husk, 1 Holy Water, 1 Needle Packet, 1 Spool.

steps.full_en: Bring these and she'll give you the Holy Threads which allow you to go to level 1 of the dungeon.
steps.full_ru: Принесите запрошенные материалы: она выдаст Holy Threads, позволяющие попасть на уровень 1 подземелья.
steps.original_instruction: Bring these and she'll give you the Holy Threads which allow you to go to level 1 of the dungeon.
steps.short_en: Bring the materials to Boonthon and receive Holy Threads for level 1.
steps.short_ru: Принесите материалы Boonthon и получите Holy Threads для уровня 1.

steps.full_en: Go outside of her house and to the far east onto the field map. continue east to an NPC that asks you if you really want to go down there, (128, 197) say yes and you'll be moved to the bottom of the valley.
steps.full_ru: Выйдите из её дома и идите на восток, на полевую карту. Продолжайте идти на восток к NPC (128, 197). На вопрос, действительно ли вы хотите спуститься, ответьте утвердительно; вас перенесут на дно долины.
steps.original_instruction: Go outside of her house and to the far east onto the field map. continue east to an NPC that asks you if you really want to go down there, (128, 197) say yes and you'll be moved to the bottom of the valley.
steps.short_en: Go east to the NPC (128, 197) and agree to go down.
steps.short_ru: Идите на восток к NPC (128, 197) и согласитесь спуститься.

step_actions.condition_text: Affirmative response; exact game menu label not established.

steps.full_en: Go to the temple, and go in.
steps.full_ru: Подойдите к храму и войдите внутрь.
steps.original_instruction: Go to the temple, and go in.
steps.short_en: Enter the temple.
steps.short_ru: Войдите в храм.

steps.full_en: Here you'll find the mapless maze. There's also a drop down pool, avoid walking into these, since they kill you if you fall down them, and you do lose EXP. You'll see 3 possible paths facing North and 3 to the West, the North facing one farthest to the West will cause a popup NPC dialogue to activate and start flashing crosses on the minimap.
steps.full_ru: Вы окажетесь в лабиринте без карты. Избегайте провалов: падение убивает персонажа и отнимает EXP. Перед вами 3 пути на север и 3 на запад. Самый западный из путей, направленных на север, запускает диалог NPC и мигающие кресты на миникарте.
steps.original_instruction: Here you'll find the mapless maze. There's also a drop down pool, avoid walking into these, since they kill you if you fall down them, and you do lose EXP. You'll see 3 possible paths facing North and 3 to the West, the North facing one farthest to the West will cause a popup NPC dialogue to activate and start flashing crosses on the minimap.
steps.short_en: Trigger the hint on the westernmost north-facing path; avoid the pits.
steps.short_ru: Запустите подсказку на самом западном северном пути; избегайте провалов.

step_actions.condition_text: Westernmost north-facing path.

steps.full_en: These are hidden panels along the way, you'll need to press them in order! | Note: Using a Fly Wing or Teleporting will cancel the crosses so you'd best have a good memory or reactivate them after each one you find. | Note2: If you Teleport around, it is possible that you land in a drop down pool! and then you'll lose experience. Map of Crosses (Approximate): Note: The dark zone in center is only a pool of water Once you activate all 6, return to Boomthon. She will make Holier Threads for you, and asks for these items: | 2 Needle Packet | 2 Holy Water | 2 Spool | 1 Yggdrasil Leaf
steps.full_ru: По пути находятся скрытые панели; нажимайте их по порядку. Fly Wing или Teleport убирают кресты: запоминайте их расположение или снова включайте подсказку после каждой найденной панели. Примечание 2: Teleport может перенести вас в провал, что приведёт к потере опыта. На примерной карте крестов тёмная центральная область — лишь водоём. После активации всех 6 панелей вернитесь к Boomthon. Для изготовления Holier Threads она попросит 2 Needle Packet, 2 Holy Water, 2 Spool и 1 Yggdrasil Leaf.
steps.original_instruction: These are hidden panels along the way, you'll need to press them in order! | Note: Using a Fly Wing or Teleporting will cancel the crosses so you'd best have a good memory or reactivate them after each one you find. | Note2: If you Teleport around, it is possible that you land in a drop down pool! and then you'll lose experience. Map of Crosses (Approximate): Note: The dark zone in center is only a pool of water Once you activate all 6, return to Boomthon. She will make Holier Threads for you, and asks for these items: | 2 Needle Packet | 2 Holy Water | 2 Spool | 1 Yggdrasil Leaf
steps.short_en: Activate 6 panels in order; return to Boomthon with 2 Needle Packet, 2 Holy Water, 2 Spool, 1 Yggdrasil Leaf.
steps.short_ru: Активируйте 6 панелей по порядку; вернитесь к Boomthon с 2 Needle Packet, 2 Holy Water, 2 Spool, 1 Yggdrasil Leaf.

step_actions.condition_text: All six panels in order; teleport resets displayed markers.

steps.full_en: After making the Holier Threads , you're able to return to the maze and access level 2!
steps.full_ru: После изготовления Holier Threads можно вернуться в лабиринт и войти на уровень 2.
steps.original_instruction: After making the Holier Threads , you're able to return to the maze and access level 2!
steps.short_en: Obtain Holier Threads and return to the maze for level 2 access.
steps.short_ru: Получите Holier Threads и вернитесь в лабиринт для доступа на уровень 2.

steps.full_en: Once you make it down to level 2, head for (268, 107). Talk to the npc tile to be given 1 Old Blue Box .
steps.full_ru: На уровне 2 идите к (268, 107). Взаимодействуйте с клеткой NPC, чтобы получить 1 Old Blue Box.
steps.original_instruction: Once you make it down to level 2, head for (268, 107). Talk to the npc tile to be given 1 Old Blue Box .
steps.short_en: On level 2 interact with the tile at (268, 107) and receive 1 Old Blue Box.
steps.short_ru: На уровне 2 взаимодействуйте с клеткой (268, 107) и получите 1 Old Blue Box.

steps.full_en: After collecting the Old Blue Box , head back to Boomthon, you will be told that because of your adventurous spirit, you should keep it.
steps.full_ru: Получив Old Blue Box, вернитесь к Boomthon. Она скажет оставить коробку себе в награду за вашу тягу к приключениям.
steps.original_instruction: After collecting the Old Blue Box , head back to Boomthon, you will be told that because of your adventurous spirit, you should keep it.
steps.short_en: Return to Boomthon; keep the Old Blue Box.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Boomthon; Old Blue Box остаётся у вас.

step_items.condition_text: Keep the already received box; not a delivery or a second reward.

rewards.condition_text: Biolabs via Sewer Pipe after escaping the laboratory.

steps.full_en: Proceed to the 3 o'clock direction of Lighthalzen . There, you'll see a guard who stops you from moving into the slum area. Fear not, just talk to him continuously and you'll eventually make it into the slums. | Note: To access the slum, either wait for any alert to cease (Mobsters in town are all killed (yellow text)), or do the Friendship Quest .
steps.full_ru: Идите на восток, в направлении 3 часов, в Lighthalzen. Стражник не пускает в трущобы: говорите с ним многократно, пока он не пропустит. Примечание: дождитесь окончания тревоги, когда все Mobsters в городе убиты (жёлтое сообщение), либо выполните Friendship Quest.
steps.original_instruction: Proceed to the 3 o'clock direction of Lighthalzen . There, you'll see a guard who stops you from moving into the slum area. Fear not, just talk to him continuously and you'll eventually make it into the slums. | Note: To access the slum, either wait for any alert to cease (Mobsters in town are all killed (yellow text)), or do the Friendship Quest .
steps.short_en: In eastern Lighthalzen, keep talking to the guard until admitted to the slums.
steps.short_ru: В восточной части Lighthalzen говорите со стражником до прохода в трущобы.

step_actions.condition_text: Repeat; access requires the alert to end or Friendship Quest.

steps.full_en: Proceed on and meet Fishbone (340,224). Talk to him continuously to find out that he's actually an ex-researcher.
steps.full_ru: Найдите Fishbone (340,224). Говорите с ним многократно, чтобы узнать, что он бывший исследователь.
steps.original_instruction: Proceed on and meet Fishbone (340,224). Talk to him continuously to find out that he's actually an ex-researcher.
steps.short_en: Keep talking to Fishbone (340,224).
steps.short_ru: Многократно поговорите с Fishbone (340,224).

step_actions.condition_text: Repeat until he reveals his past.

steps.full_en: Talk to him again and again, you'll be pleading with him till he eventually asks for an offer of 20 Jellopy for an exchange of information.
steps.full_ru: Продолжайте разговаривать и упрашивать его, пока он не попросит 20 Jellopy в обмен на информацию.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to him again and again, you'll be pleading with him till he eventually asks for an offer of 20 Jellopy for an exchange of information.
steps.short_en: Keep talking to Fishbone until he asks for 20 Jellopy.
steps.short_ru: Добейтесь просьбы Fishbone принести 20 Jellopy.

steps.full_en: Once you've passed him the Jellopies, ask him to send you to the maze. | This is a map of the cuberoom maze (unless its changed). The portals marked R moves you to a random one of the three green marked rooms. You'll actually start in one of those 3 rooms too. To make it slightly more random, the exit portal doesn't always actually take you out of the maze, you may have to work your way back again.
steps.full_ru: Передав ему Jellopies, попросите отправить вас в лабиринт. На приведённой карте cuberoom (если она не изменилась) порталы R переносят в случайную из трёх зелёных комнат. Начинаете вы также в одной из этих 3 комнат. Выходной портал иногда не выводит из лабиринта, и путь приходится проходить снова.
steps.original_instruction: Once you've passed him the Jellopies, ask him to send you to the maze. | This is a map of the cuberoom maze (unless its changed). The portals marked R moves you to a random one of the three green marked rooms. You'll actually start in one of those 3 rooms too. To make it slightly more random, the exit portal doesn't always actually take you out of the maze, you may have to work your way back again.
steps.short_en: Give Jellopy to Fishbone and ask to enter the maze.
steps.short_ru: Передайте Jellopy Fishbone и попросите отправить вас в лабиринт.

steps.full_en: Type /where in there, until you get to a room with any of these coordinates: [67,193] go to direction 12, 3, 9, 12, 9 (o'clock), or [66,136] go to direction 3, 12, 6, 6, 9 (o'clock), or [67,74] go to direction 6, 3, 9, 6, 9 (o'clock). You'll be sent to a room with documents all over. | However, sometimes when it is bugged and you don't get to the next room but just remain in maze, just repeat this step. Second time will be successful. [123,18] is the last room where you go to 9 o'clock direction as shown on the picture.
steps.full_ru: Введите /where. Для комнаты [67,193] идите по направлениям часов 12, 3, 9, 12, 9; для [66,136] — 3, 12, 6, 6, 9; для [67,74] — 6, 3, 9, 6, 9. Вы попадёте в комнату с документами. Если из-за ошибки вы остались в лабиринте, повторите этап: источник утверждает, что вторая попытка успешна. [123,18] — последняя комната; выход из неё находится в направлении 9 часов, как на рисунке.
steps.original_instruction: Type /where in there, until you get to a room with any of these coordinates: [67,193] go to direction 12, 3, 9, 12, 9 (o'clock), or [66,136] go to direction 3, 12, 6, 6, 9 (o'clock), or [67,74] go to direction 6, 3, 9, 6, 9 (o'clock). You'll be sent to a room with documents all over. | However, sometimes when it is bugged and you don't get to the next room but just remain in maze, just repeat this step. Second time will be successful. [123,18] is the last room where you go to 9 o'clock direction as shown on the picture.
steps.short_en: Check /where and follow the route for your room; repeat if the exit fails.
steps.short_ru: Проверьте /where и следуйте маршруту для своей комнаты; при сбое повторите путь.

step_actions.condition_text: Select the route by /where coordinates; no universal start room.

steps.full_en: Examine the Bed, you'll get a Short Stick if you checked under the bed.
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Bed и загляните под кровать, чтобы получить Short Stick.
steps.original_instruction: Examine the Bed, you'll get a Short Stick if you checked under the bed.
steps.short_en: Look under the Bed and take the Short Stick.
steps.short_ru: Осмотрите Bed снизу и возьмите Short Stick.

steps.full_en: Examine the Desk (under the Desk), you'll get another Short Stick . The two rods will become a Long Stick automatically. Use the Long Stick on the Bed (under the Bed) and obtain a Cube .
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Desk снизу, чтобы получить ещё один Short Stick. Два прута автоматически превратятся в Long Stick. Примените Long Stick под Bed и получите Cube.
steps.original_instruction: Examine the Desk (under the Desk), you'll get another Short Stick . The two rods will become a Long Stick automatically. Use the Long Stick on the Bed (under the Bed) and obtain a Cube .
steps.short_en: Find Short Stick under the Desk; use Long Stick under the Bed to obtain Cube.
steps.short_ru: Найдите Short Stick под Desk; примените Long Stick под Bed и получите Cube.

steps.full_en: Examine the Goblet on the table beside the bookshelf. Check its contents, you'll obtain a Rusty Key .
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Goblet на столе рядом с книжной полкой. Проверьте содержимое, чтобы получить Rusty Key.
steps.original_instruction: Examine the Goblet on the table beside the bookshelf. Check its contents, you'll obtain a Rusty Key .
steps.short_en: Check the Goblet contents to obtain Rusty Key.
steps.short_ru: Проверьте содержимое Goblet и получите Rusty Key.

steps.full_en: Move towards the wall at the desk. You'll see a cabinet of Chemicals. Examine it and type in Rusty Key and you'll get a Green Key .
steps.full_ru: У стены рядом со столом найдите шкаф Chemicals. Осмотрите его и введите Rusty Key, чтобы получить Green Key.
steps.original_instruction: Move towards the wall at the desk. You'll see a cabinet of Chemicals. Examine it and type in Rusty Key and you'll get a Green Key .
steps.short_en: At Chemicals, type “Rusty Key” to obtain Green Key.
steps.short_ru: У Chemicals введите «Rusty Key» и получите Green Key.

steps.full_en: Move to the Cabinet on the right of the room. Examine it and type in Green Key . You'll obtain a Polygon .
steps.full_ru: Подойдите к Cabinet справа в комнате. Осмотрите его и введите Green Key, чтобы получить Polygon.
steps.original_instruction: Move to the Cabinet on the right of the room. Examine it and type in Green Key . You'll obtain a Polygon .
steps.short_en: At Cabinet, type “Green Key” to obtain Polygon.
steps.short_ru: У Cabinet введите «Green Key» и получите Polygon.

steps.full_en: Next, examine the Bundles of Files on the ground. You'll obtain a Red Key .
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Bundles of Files на полу, чтобы получить Red Key.
steps.original_instruction: Next, examine the Bundles of Files on the ground. You'll obtain a Red Key .
steps.short_en: Inspect Bundles of Files to obtain Red Key.
steps.short_ru: Осмотрите Bundles of Files и получите Red Key.

steps.full_en: Examine the Drawer next to the Bed and type in Red Key , you'll obtain a Jackknif e.
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Drawer рядом с Bed и введите Red Key. Вы получите Jackknif e (написание источника).
steps.original_instruction: Examine the Drawer next to the Bed and type in Red Key , you'll obtain a Jackknif e.
steps.short_en: At Drawer, type “Red Key”; the source names the reward Jackknif e.
steps.short_ru: У Drawer введите «Red Key»; в источнике награда названа Jackknif e.

steps.full_en: Examine the Painting above the Desk. You'll select the option to move it. Type in Jackknife . You'll obtain a set of numbers. Write these down or take a screenshot.
steps.full_ru: Осмотрите Painting над Desk. Выберите действие, перемещающее картину, и введите Jackknife. Полученные числа запишите или сохраните снимком экрана.
steps.original_instruction: Examine the Painting above the Desk. You'll select the option to move it. Type in Jackknife . You'll obtain a set of numbers. Write these down or take a screenshot.
steps.short_en: At Painting, type “Jackknife” and save the displayed numbers.
steps.short_ru: У Painting введите «Jackknife» и сохраните показанные числа.

steps.full_en: Now, move on the the right hand corner of the room to find a Chest. Take the Axe in it.
steps.full_ru: В правом углу комнаты найдите Chest и возьмите из него Axe.
steps.original_instruction: Now, move on the the right hand corner of the room to find a Chest. Take the Axe in it.
steps.short_en: Take Axe from the Chest in the right corner.
steps.short_ru: Возьмите Axe из Chest в правом углу.

branches.condition_text: Use only when the wall displays two-digit numbers with second digits ordering the sequence.
branches.full_en: Examine the Barrel again. It asks for 9 numbers. The key to this puzzle are the numbers you obtained in step 13. Take the second digit of each number and arrange them in order from 1-9. The code will be the each of the first digits. Example: Code on the wall: 53 86 49 34 18 21 77 92 65 Numbers in Order by second digit: 21 92 53 34 65 86 77 18 49 Code to unlock the box: 2 9 5 3 6 8 7 1 4 Type in the numbers you got (Remember everyones code will be different. Only use the numbers you got from the picture on the wall.), one at a time. You'll then obtain a Yellow Key .
branches.full_ru: Снова осмотрите Barrel: он запрашивает 9 чисел. Используйте числа, полученные в этапе 13. Расположите их по второй цифре от 1 до 9; код составляют первые цифры. Пример: на стене 53 86 49 34 18 21 77 92 65; порядок по второй цифре — 21 92 53 34 65 86 77 18 49; код — 2 9 5 3 6 8 7 1 4. Вводите свои числа по одному: код у каждого игрока отличается, используйте только числа с собственной картины. Затем вы получите Yellow Key.
branches.short_en: At Barrel, sort your own two-digit numbers by second digit and enter the first digits.

branches.condition_text: Father-first route.
branches.full_en: Option A : Go To Father Bamph First 1A. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 2A. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 3A. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 4A. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. He will ask you to bring some relief to Bonnie Imbullea. (Gain 1,600,000 base experience) 5A. Go back to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Tell her that the exorcism is not her fault and good news will arrive soon. 6A. Go to Rodafrian. There will be 2 options here, i) Tell her about the curse: - She will be grateful and tell you about Western Region and Jormungand. Return to Father Bamph one last time to complete the quest. ii) Not telling her: - Rodafrian will be thankful of your help to solve her mystery. (Quest Finished)
branches.full_ru: Option A: сначала Father Bamph. 1A. Вернитесь к Father Bamph: он попросит проверить, были ли принцы отравлены. 2A. В мавзолее осмотрите 3-го принца, имея 1 Green Potion и 1 Yellow Gemstone. 3A. Змеиная отметина исчезнет; вернитесь в церковный кабинет. 4A. Father Bamph запретит пока разглашать результат и попросит успокоить Bonnie Imbullea. Получите 1,600,000 base experience. 5A. Вернитесь к Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268), объясните, что изгнание не её вина и скоро придут хорошие вести. 6A. Посетите Rodafrian. Здесь 2 варианта: i) рассказать о проклятии — она расскажет о Western Region и Jormungand, после чего нужно ещё раз вернуться к Father Bamph для завершения; ii) не рассказывать — Rodafrian поблагодарит за помощь, и квест завершится.
branches.short_en: Visit Father Bamph first; receive EXP before visiting Bonnie Imbullea.
branches.short_ru: Сначала Father Bamph; получите EXP до посещения Bonnie Imbullea.
branches.variant_scope: Classic wiki route; server applicability unverified

branches.condition_text: Historian-first route; disclose information, then obtain EXP from Biscuss before Bonnie.
branches.full_en: Option B : Go To Historian Rodafrian First (this is a dangerous option, as there is a failure path on this branch) 1B. Go to Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126) and tell her the last verse of the rhyme. Choose either tell her about the poisoned princes or not to tell. i) Tell her about the curse: - 1Bi. She will be grateful and tell you about the Western Region and Jormungand. 2Bi. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 3Bi. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 4Bi. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 5Bi. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. 6Bi. Talk to Father Biscuss (prt_church 184, 110) and he will thank you for your trouble. (Quest Finished, you receive EXP, and may now talk to Bonnie) | Note: If you speak to Bonnie prior to getting the EXP from Biscuss you will FAIL and get no EXP from this quest. This is due to breaking the Priest's edict of not telling anyone two times prior to them giving you clearance to do so.
branches.full_ru: Option B: сначала Historian Rodafrian; у этого пути есть исход без награды. 1B. У Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126) расскажите последнюю строку рифмовки и решите, сообщать ли об отравленных принцах. i) Рассказать о проклятии. 1Bi. Она поблагодарит и расскажет о Western Region и Jormungand. 2Bi. Вернитесь к Father Bamph: он попросит проверить отравление. 3Bi. В мавзолее осмотрите 3-го принца, имея 1 Green Potion и 1 Yellow Gemstone. 4Bi. Отметина исчезнет; вернитесь в церковный кабинет. 5Bi. Father Bamph запретит пока разглашать результат. 6Bi. Поговорите с Father Biscuss (prt_church 184, 110): он поблагодарит, квест завершится и вы получите EXP. Только после этого можно говорить с Bonnie. steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в Morroc, обязательно выйдя из здания обычным путём: teleport или butterfly wing могут вызвать проблемы. Выберите дальнейший путь: A — сначала вернуться к Father Bamph; B — сообщить Rodafrian. Второй путь может нарушить запрет священника и закончить квест без Exp.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Morroc (you must leave the building normally, using teleport or butterfly wing will cause problems!). You will reflect on what you now know, and have to decide on one of the following: A. Go back to Father Bamph first, or B. Inform Rodafrian. (This could violate the priest's edict and cause a quest complete without Exp) Option A : Go To Father Bamph First 1A. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 2A. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 3A. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 4A. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. He will ask you to bring some relief to Bonnie Imbullea. (Gain 1,600,000 base experience) 5A. Go back to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Tell her that the exorcism is not her fault and good news will arrive soon. 6A. Go to Rodafrian. There will be 2 options here, i) Tell her about the curse: - She will be grateful and tell you about Western Region and Jormungand. Return to Father Bamph one last time to complete the quest. ii) Not telling her: - Rodafrian will be thankful of your help to solve her mystery. (Quest Finished) Option B : Go To Historian Rodafrian First (this is a dangerous option, as there is a failure path on this branch) 1B. Go to Rodafrian (morocc_in 45, 126) and tell her the last verse of the rhyme. Choose either tell her about the poisoned princes or not to tell. i) Tell her about the curse: - 1Bi. She will be grateful and tell you about the Western Region and Jormungand. 2Bi. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 3Bi. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 4Bi. The serpent mark will vanish. Go back to the church office to discuss further. 5Bi. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. 6Bi. Talk to Father Biscuss (prt_church 184, 110) and he will thank you for your trouble. (Quest Finished, you receive EXP, and may now talk to Bonnie) | Note: If you speak to Bonnie prior to getting the EXP from Biscuss you will FAIL and get no EXP from this quest. This is due to breaking the Priest's edict of not telling anyone two times prior to them giving you clearance to do so. ii) Not telling her: - 1Bii. Rodafrian will be thankful for your help. 2Bii. Go back to Father Bamph. He will ask you to verify if the princes are poisoned or not. 3Bii. Go to the mausoleum. Check on the 3rd prince. (Must have 1 Green Potion and 1 Yellow Gemstone). 4Bii. The serpent mark will vanish. Talk to the Father Bamph that stands next to the corpses first, then go back to the church office to discuss further. 5Bii. Father Bamph will ask you not to reveal the results to anyone yet due to the impact of the matter. He will ask you to bring some relief to Bonnie Imbullea. (Gain 1,600,000 base experience) 6Bii. Go back to Bonnie Imbullea (mjolnir_01 316, 268). Tell her that the exorcism is not her fault and good news will arrive soon. (Quest Finished)
steps.short_en: Leave normally; choose route A or B and follow its conversation order to retain EXP.
steps.short_ru: Выйдите обычным путём; выберите маршрут A или B и соблюдайте порядок разговоров ради EXP.

steps.full_en: Now following the Elder's instructions you will need to head to the Rekenber Headquarters. As you enter into this building you will walk forward and trigger another spirit (lhz_in01 113 150). After triggering the spirit you will want to continue forward towards the Representative and ask about the Corporation's History. She will then guide you to the Library.
steps.full_ru: Следуя указаниям Elder, войдите в Rekenber Headquarters. Пройдите вперёд, чтобы вызвать ещё одного духа (lhz_in01 113 150). Затем подойдите к Representative и спросите о Corporation's History. Она направит вас в Library.

steps.full_en: Now head to your left into the Library (lhz_in01 27 247) and talk to the Representative there. Talk to her about the Corporation's History and listen closely to what she says. You will need to talk to her again and discuss Rekenber's Businesses with her to find out more about what has been going on. She will then guide you to look up the Guidebook to find more about Rekenber's businesses. Clicking on the Guidebook and reading what little information there is will help you understand the mission that was at hand.

steps.full_en: Realizing that you might be in over your head and yet still curious as to what is going on, you head back towards the Library. As you get closer you see a Rekenber Guard , almost like you walked right past him earlier. Talk to the guard and he will request your ID to be confirmed. You will need a Grandpa's Beard and Geek Glasses, as you can tell from his own ID, before he will let you pass. File:Guard.jpg Once you have put on the Grandpa Beard and Geek Glasses you can then talk to the Rekenber Guard and he will let you into the room.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Mad Scientist again as it would seem he was too distracted to give you the right attention you requested for. Ask to speak to him again, and he will give you a hint of what he needs. Round and Shiny? Must be a Glass Bead ! Bring back a Glass Bead to him again and politely ask him about his work. He will give you some details about what he is working on and how he feels it will change the world.
steps.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Mad Scientist, который отвлёкся в прошлый раз. Попросите выслушать вас: он намекнёт на нужный предмет — «Round and Shiny?», то есть Glass Bead. Принесите Glass Bead и вежливо спросите о работе. Он расскажет о своём исследовании и надеждах изменить мир.

steps.full_en: Let's wander around, and head to the room to the north. See if what this Mad Scientist is talking about will really change the world. Moving into the north room, (lhz_in01 282 166) you will circle around a table in the middle of the room and find something on the floor. Oh wait! It's a door to another room. As you enter you notice this room looks just like the one you came from. If you move around the room you will see what looks to be some sort of testing going on.

steps.full_en: You remember that the Elder said to return once you find what you are looking for. Head back to the Elder and see if she can help by showing her the pendant. The pendant looks to have a curse on it, something that she claims to be able to fix. Return to her with 5 Holy Water (from a local priest or Merman ) and a Bouquet (from Prontera's Flower Girl) as she has requested. Once you return to her with the 5 Holy Water and the Bouquet she will calm the curse and ask you to return the pendant to its rightful owner.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Elder и покажите pendant. Она скажет, что может снять с него проклятие. Принесите 5 Holy Water, полученные у священника или с Merman, и Bouquet у Flower Girl в Prontera. Вернувшись с 5 Holy Water и Bouquet, вы успокоите проклятие; Elder попросит вернуть pendant владельцу.

steps.full_en: If you head north in the slums district (lighthalzen 319,321) you will come to a house with a Crippled Girl (lhz_in03 31,162) that looks to be in some serious discomfort. Talk to the girl and show her the pendant, and listen to her story of what the pendant means to her. Then tell her as gently as possible, and then offer her some comfort. If you tell her the brutal truth and get kicked out, simply keep retrying to enter the building and the door will eventually unlock.

steps.full_en: The search for a true answer hasn't stopped, and you figure that this spirit that continues to follow you has something to do with the Rekenber Corporation and you feel the need to continue there. You head to speak with a Secretary; Secretary Slierre (lhz_in01 286 226). You ask Slierre about the slums, only to find out she doesn't know much about them. So you talk to her again and ask about the Laboratory, and she gives you a vague question and pushes you off to the help desk. Realizing she isn't going to answer your questions in a round about manner, you come out with it and ask about Wolfchev's Research. Stunned, she inquires about why you asked, and you explain that you are a friend of his. She tries to brush you off, but you reply with W-Wait!, and you ask again about Wolfchev's Research. She explains that she is not able to answer your questions but if you have something to show her then she is more then willing to help you. So you ask about Wolchev's Test Subjects, ignoring her statement of not being able to help. At this point she attempts to sway the conversation towards the positive aspects of the research and you claim that his experiments are suspicious and you don't trust the corporation. Not claiming to know anything, she asks for proof, so you show her the evidence. You show her the Handcuffs and Slierre becomes bothered by this proof. You ask what Wolfchev is doing now, and you explain that, Yes you are suspicious about his research, and question about Mr. Wolfchev and the creatures in Regenschirm. She takes your claims and asks that you give her time to go over it all and see if there is any truth to this report.
steps.full_ru: Продолжите расследование у Secretary Slierre (lhz_in01 286 226). Спросите Slierre о трущобах, затем о Laboratory. После уклончивых ответов спросите о Wolfchev's Research и объясните, что вы его друг. Когда она попытается закончить разговор, ответьте «W-Wait!» и снова спросите о Wolfchev's Research. На отказ отвечать спросите о Wolchev's Test Subjects. Выразите сомнения в исследованиях и недоверие корпорации. В качестве доказательства покажите Handcuffs. Затем спросите, чем теперь занимается Wolfchev, подтвердите подозрения относительно Mr. Wolfchev и существ в Regenschirm. Она попросит время на проверку сведений.

steps.full_en: Go to Einbech . When you step off the train there is a Young Man (einbech 58 209) who talks about depressed guy in pub. Go talk to Buender Hikeman behind the tavern (einbech 164 102). He will mistake you for a killer. Talk to him again, and ask him how he escaped. He'll rant and pass out.
steps.full_ru: Идите в Einbech. У станции Young Man (einbech 58 209) расскажет о подавленном человеке в пабе. Поговорите с Buender Hikeman за таверной (einbech 164 102). Он примет вас за убийцу. Поговорите снова и спросите, как он спасся; он начнёт бредить и потеряет сознание.

steps.full_en: Now head to Einbroch . At the second floor of the Hotel (einbroch 252 200), in the south eastern room there is a Sick Old Man - Shinokas (ein_in01 231, 161) in bed. Ask him if he always lived in Einbroch and you'll find out he is hiding something. Keep badgering him about the mine collapse and eventually you'll get the option to ask about Hikeman. He will slip up and reveal he really was part of that incident. Talk to him again and he asks you to search the Kappelthaine Manor (einbroch 126 229) for more information about the ore. Talk to the maid there and she denies any ore. | Note: To talk to NPCs in the Kappelthaine Manor, immediately move into the south room upon entering. The father will kick you out of the house if you go near him, so you have to talk to the three NPCs in the room (two are for another quest) through the walls.
steps.full_ru: Идите в Einbroch. На втором этаже Hotel (einbroch 252 200), в юго-восточной комнате, лежит Sick Old Man — Shinokas (ein_in01 231, 161). Спросите, всегда ли он жил в Einbroch. Продолжайте расспрашивать об обрушении шахты, затем о Hikeman. Снова поговорите с ним: он направит в Kappelthaine Manor (einbroch 126 229) узнать о руде. Поговорите с maid; она всё отрицает. Примечание: сразу после входа в Kappelthaine Manor идите в южную комнату. father выгонит вас, если подойти к нему. С тремя NPCs в комнате говорите через стены; два из них относятся к другому квесту.

steps.full_en: Talk to the scientist inside, and he will tell you the head of the lab is on the airship flirting with some lady. While here, click on the small "Unknown Stuff" in the middle of the room at the center of the machine.

steps.full_en: Take the airship and go downstairs (airplane 34 77). The scientist (Drunken Old Man) is throwing dice and losing badly. Talk to the Apple Merchant, buy 100 apples, then talk to the scientist. He'll use them to gamble another round and lose even more. The key here is his swearing his luck on Ymir's Heart. Keep giving him apples and eventually he will win, and tell you about Ymir's Heart.
steps.full_ru: Сядьте на airship и спуститесь вниз (airplane 34 77). scientist (Drunken Old Man) проигрывает в кости. У Apple Merchant купите 100 apples, затем поговорите с scientist: он использует их для новой ставки и снова проиграет. Важна его клятва удачей на Ymir's Heart. Продолжайте давать apples, пока он не выиграет и не расскажет о Ymir's Heart.

steps.full_en: Inside the Einbroch Factory (the factory is located at the center bottom of the city Einbroch 179, 70), there is a friendly factory supervisor, Zelmeto ((ein_in01): 67, 242). He'll talks about the hardship and under staffing in the factory. After deciding to help him, he suggests inspecting parts of the factory.

steps.full_en: Zelmeto will talk to the manager and request that the parts be fixed. Head out the back entrance to the factory to find the big fat ugly Liotzburg ((einbroch): 132, 84). He is the factory manager, and reveals he's too stingy to use his money for the factory.

Источник описывает его как крупного, полного и некрасивого управляющего; он признаётся, что слишком скуп, чтобы тратить деньги на фабрику.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Yggdrasil Gatekeeper at (nyd_dun02 99, 199). How to reach the gatekeeper: Enter Yggdrasil Dungeon at (spl_fld01 368, 112). Enter the portal located at 3 o'clock of the map (nyd_dun01 252, 144) (not shown on minimap). The portal markings on the minimap are exits only. Once in level 2, walk right until you've reached a cliff. Control the "Strange Device" at (nyd_dun02 137, 274), and cross the canyon by stepping on the circles. Stepping anywhere outside the shown circles will return you to the bottom right corner of the previous map. After crossing the cliff, follow the path consisting of stairs and roots until you've arrived at a gate at (nyd_dun02 99, 199).

Используйте Strange Device (nyd_dun02 137, 274) и переходите каньон, наступая на круги. Шаг вне кругов вернёт в нижний правый угол предыдущей карты. После обрыва идите по лестницам и корням к воротам (nyd_dun02 99, 199).

steps.full_en: Talk to Hallen on the Juno (or any Domestic flight) Airship (airplane 236 63). Ask him what he's doing, then talk to him a second time. He asks you to deliver a letter to his cousin Kaci (airplane 36 70), which can be found near the gaming tables under deck. Talk to Kaci again, selecting all of the options, then talk to Hallen. Agree that helping other people is good.
steps.full_ru: На Juno или любом Domestic flight Airship поговорите с Hallen (airplane 236 63). Спросите о занятии и поговорите второй раз. Он попросит передать письмо кузине Kaci (airplane 36 70) у игровых столов под палубой. Поговорите с Kaci ещё раз, выберите все варианты, затем вернитесь к Hallen и согласитесь, что помогать людям хорошо.

Agree that helping other people is good.

steps.full_en: At (ein_in01 264 16), walk around to get the password checker (Dialogue Box activates when you walk over a certain spot) to decode the password and get the information. Step over to the machine at (ein_in01 261 35) to start decoding. The code is of the same kind as the one you need to get the yellow Key for Thanatos Tower; you have five tries to enter the correct three digit code (numbers 1-9) where every digit is different. Note: if you'd like help finding the number, try this site .

Код похож на код для yellow Key в Thanatos Tower: есть пять попыток угадать трёхзначный код из цифр 1-9 без повторов. Примечание: источник предлагает внешний сайт помощи; универсальный готовый код не указан.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Captain, Tarlock (airplane_01 238 154) and ask "How does the airship fly?" Pester him once more. Tarlock will ask if you really want to know, answer yes. Then he says it's top secret and only tells you if you help him. He then says he has a brother who also is an Airship Captain, Ferlock. Because they work in different airships, Tarlock asks you to deliver a letter to him and get his brother's reply. You receive Tarlock's Letter.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с капитаном Tarlock (airplane_01 238 154) и спросите «How does the airship fly?». Расспросите снова и подтвердите желание узнать. Он предложит помощь в обмен на секрет: доставить письмо брату Ferlock, капитану другого дирижабля, и принести ответ. Получите Tarlock's Letter.

steps.full_en: Board the Domestic route airship (from Juno to Lighthalzen to Einbroch to Hugel ) and find Air Ship Captain, Ferlock (airplane 236 163) (you can switch between the two routes at the Juno airport without having to pay the boarding fee a second time). After you give him Tarlock's letter he tells you his brother has borrowed something from him and apparently has lost it. Ferlock shows you the letter that says "The one who brought you the letter will find it for me. Don't reply to me if he refuses to do so". Ferlock tells you those items were 2 Will of the Darkness and 2 Prickly Fruit and the monsters that drop it can be found on Tarlock's Airship. | Note: If you already have the required items in your inventory, you can skip step 4 and proceed straight to step 5.
steps.full_ru: Сядьте на Domestic route airship: Juno → Lighthalzen → Einbroch → Hugel. Найдите Air Ship Captain, Ferlock (airplane 236 163). Между маршрутами можно пересесть в Juno без повторной платы. Передайте Tarlock's letter. Из письма следует: «The one who brought you the letter will find it for me. Don't reply to me if he refuses to do so». Ferlock попросит 2 Will of the Darkness и 2 Prickly Fruit с монстров на дирижабле Tarlock. Если предметы уже есть, пропустите этап 4 и переходите сразу к этапу 5.

steps.full_en: Go back to International route airship ( Izlude / Juno / Rachel ) and wait patiently on the deck. Eventually, you will hear an announcement. | Note: This happens at a random rate and if you are unlucky, there is a chance that it might not happen for days. After this announcement, half of the mobs are killed by Captain Tarlock and will drop nothing. You should try to kill the monsters as fast as possible. | After 4 minutes, another announcement is made. If you don't clear the monsters by that time, they will die (With no items). Gremlin and Beholder can also be found in Rachel Sanctuary dungeons after completing the Rachel Sanctuary Quest .
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь на International route airship (Izlude / Juno / Rachel) и ждите объявления на палубе. Событие происходит случайно; при неудаче его можно ждать днями. После объявления Captain Tarlock уничтожает половину монстров без добычи: старайтесь убивать быстрее. Через 4 минуты будет новое объявление; оставшиеся монстры погибнут без предметов. Gremlin и Beholder также встречаются в Rachel Sanctuary dungeons после Rachel Sanctuary Quest.

steps.full_en: El Schatt finally realizes that Kanainne is talking to him and gives up cutting the trees down.
steps.full_ru: El Schatt наконец понимает, что с ним говорит Kanainne, и отказывается рубить деревья.

steps.short_en: Wait for El Schatt to give up cutting down the trees.
steps.short_ru: Дождитесь, пока El Schatt откажется рубить деревья.

steps.full_en: Rewarded with 50,000 Base EXP and an Old Blue Box .
steps.full_ru: Получите награду: 50,000 Base EXP и Old Blue Box.

steps.full_en: In Rachel (157, 183 rachel), find the Sincere Follower, Urstia. Talk to her and agree to help her. She gives the player an Ashy Necklace .
steps.full_ru: В Rachel (157, 183 rachel) найдите Sincere Follower, Urstia. Поговорите и согласитесь помочь. Она выдаст Ashy Necklace.
steps.original_instruction: In Rachel (157, 183 rachel), find the Sincere Follower, Urstia. Talk to her and agree to help her. She gives the player an Ashy Necklace .
steps.short_en: Talk to Urstia: rachel 157, 183, and receive Ashy Necklace.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Urstia: rachel 157, 183, и получите Ashy Necklace.

steps.full_en: On Ice Dungeon Level 2 , find Maheo frozen in ice (ice_dun02 120, 105). He tells an embarrassing story, and asks that the player get his master to help free him.
steps.full_ru: На Ice Dungeon Level 2 найдите Maheo, замёрзшего во льду (ice_dun02 120, 105). Он расскажет неловкую историю и попросит обратиться к его учителю за помощью.
steps.original_instruction: On Ice Dungeon Level 2 , find Maheo frozen in ice (ice_dun02 120, 105). He tells an embarrassing story, and asks that the player get his master to help free him.
steps.short_en: Talk to Maheo: ice_dun02 120, 105.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Maheo: ice_dun02 120, 105.

steps.full_en: Go back to the city of Rachel, and near the top of the lake in the bottom right you will find Hamion (264, 98). He will ask that you bring him 5 Rough Wind , 1 Hammer , and 1 Blank Scroll . (Hammer [2]s are available in Rachel's weapon shop (42, 111), and Blank Scrolls can be bought in the Magical Academy in Juno (yuno 323, 282)). When you bring him these items, he will give you a Wind Hammer
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в Rachel. У северного края озера в юго-восточной части города найдите Hamion (264, 98). Принесите 5 Rough Wind, 1 Hammer и 1 Blank Scroll. Hammer [2]s продаются в оружейном магазине Rachel (42, 111); Blank Scrolls — в Magical Academy в Juno (yuno 323, 282). Передав предметы, получите Wind Hammer.
steps.original_instruction: Go back to the city of Rachel, and near the top of the lake in the bottom right you will find Hamion (264, 98). (Hammer [2]s are available in Rachel's weapon shop (42, 111), and Blank Scrolls can be bought in the Magical Academy in Juno (yuno 323, 282)). When you bring him these items, he will give you a Wind Hammer
steps.short_en: Bring Hamion (264, 98): 5 Rough Wind, 1 Hammer, 1 Blank Scroll.
steps.short_ru: Принесите Hamion (264, 98): 5 Rough Wind, 1 Hammer, 1 Blank Scroll.

steps.full_en: Return to Maheo and use the hammer to smash the ice. He will reward you by restoring Urstia's Necklace to a Sparkling Necklace. You will also receive 4 Freezing Snow Powder
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Maheo и разбейте лёд молотом. В награду он восстановит Urstia's Necklace до Sparkling Necklace. Также вы получите 4 Freezing Snow Powder.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Maheo and use the hammer to smash the ice. He will reward you by restoring Urstia's Necklace to a Sparkling Necklace. You will also receive 4 Freezing Snow Powder
steps.short_en: Free Maheo using the hammer; receive Sparkling Necklace and 4 Freezing Snow Powder.
steps.short_ru: Освободите Maheo молотом; получите Sparkling Necklace и 4 Freezing Snow Powder.

steps.full_en: Return to Urstia to receive 700,000 Base Experience.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Urstia за 700,000 Base Experience.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Urstia to receive 700,000 Base Experience.
steps.short_en: Return to Urstia for 700,000 Base Experience.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Urstia за 700,000 Base Experience.

steps.full_en: (Optional) Using the 4 Freezing Snow Powder you can put out the 4 sacred fires that surround the seal at the center of Ice Dungeon Level 3 . Once put out, the boss monster Ktullanux will appear.
steps.full_ru: Необязательно: используйте 4 Freezing Snow Powder, чтобы погасить 4 священных огня вокруг печати в центре Ice Dungeon Level 3. После этого появится босс Ktullanux.
steps.original_instruction: (Optional) Using the 4 Freezing Snow Powder you can put out the 4 sacred fires that surround the seal at the center of Ice Dungeon Level 3 . Once put out, the boss monster Ktullanux will appear.

steps.full_ru: После завершения этапов 1-5 можно продавать Glacial Hearts Mohadin в Rachel (rachel 113, 97) по 375 Zeny за штуку. Сражаться с Ktullanux для этого не требуется.

steps.short_en: After steps 1-5, Mohadin (rachel 113, 97) buys Glacial Hearts for 375 Zeny each.

steps.full_en: With 1 Meat in your inventory, go to the second floor of the inn in east Prontera (prontera 204, 188) and talk with Morrison. Show him the meat, but decline to give it to him when he asks for it. Tip: You can buy Meat from the Butcher at (prontera 64, 125).
steps.full_ru: Имея в инвентаре 1 Meat, поднимитесь на второй этаж гостиницы в восточной части Prontera (prontera 204, 188) и поговорите с Morrison. Покажите ему мясо, но откажитесь отдавать его, когда он попросит. Подсказка: Meat можно купить у Butcher в точке (prontera 64, 125).
steps.original_instruction: With 1 Meat in your inventory, go to the second floor of the inn in east Prontera (prontera 204, 188) and talk with Morrison. Show him the meat, but decline to give it to him when he asks for it. Tip: You can buy Meat from the Butcher at (prontera 64, 125).
steps.short_en: Show Morrison 1 Meat upstairs in the east Prontera inn (prontera 204, 188), but do not give it to him.
steps.short_ru: Покажите Morrison 1 Meat на втором этаже гостиницы в Prontera (prontera 204, 188), но не отдавайте его.

steps.full_en: Talk with Marianne, who mentions hearing of someone in another town who produces fruit juice.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Marianne: она расскажет, что слышала о человеке в другом городе, который производит фруктовый сок.
steps.original_instruction: Talk with Marianne, who mentions hearing of someone in another town who produces fruit juice.
steps.short_en: Talk to Marianne about the fruit juice maker.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Marianne о производителе сока.

steps.full_en: Go to the fruit juice workshop in Payon , at (payon 155, 327), and talk with Marx Hansen, who offers to make fruit juice for you. To make a single bottle of fruit juice, he requires one piece of fruit, one Empty Potion Bottle , and 3 zeny. He can make juice from Apples , Bananas , Carrots , and Grapes .
steps.full_ru: Идите в мастерскую фруктового сока в Payon, в точку (payon 155, 327), и поговорите с Marx Hansen: он предложит изготовить для вас сок. Для одной бутылки ему нужны один фрукт, одна Empty Potion Bottle и 3 zeny. Он делает сок из Apples, Bananas, Carrots и Grapes.
steps.original_instruction: Go to the fruit juice workshop in Payon , at (payon 155, 327), and talk with Marx Hansen, who offers to make fruit juice for you. To make a single bottle of fruit juice, he requires one piece of fruit, one Empty Potion Bottle , and 3 zeny. He can make juice from Apples , Bananas , Carrots , and Grapes .
steps.short_en: Meet Marx Hansen in Payon (payon 155, 327); one juice costs a fruit, an Empty Potion Bottle and 3 zeny.
steps.short_ru: Найдите Marx Hansen в Payon (payon 155, 327); для одной бутылки сока нужны фрукт, Empty Potion Bottle и 3 zeny.
