steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Jenny: rachel 48, 236.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Idle Merchant (rachel 138, 73), who tells you he hasn't seen anyone and offers a rather disgusting "mock vegetable!"
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Idle Merchant (rachel 138, 73). Он скажет, что никого не видел, и предложит весьма неприятный «mock vegetable!».
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Idle Merchant (rachel 138, 73), who tells you he hasn't seen anyone and offers a rather disgusting "mock vegetable!"
steps.short_en: Talk to Idle Merchant: rachel 138, 73.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Idle Merchant: rachel 138, 73.

steps.full_en: Talk to the other Idle Merchant (rachel 120, 47), who tells you someone sent a message for you to come to the Ice Cave.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с другим Idle Merchant (rachel 120, 47). Он передаст сообщение с просьбой прийти в Ice Cave.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the other Idle Merchant (rachel 120, 47), who tells you someone sent a message for you to come to the Ice Cave.
steps.short_en: Talk to the other Idle Merchant: rachel 120, 47.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с другим Idle Merchant: rachel 120, 47.

steps.full_en: Head to the Ice Cave (1 map right, 3 maps up from Rachel ,) and talk to the Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245, 325). He attempts to kill you (You lose half your HP), but fails. You both then realize Vincent set you up, and you go back to talk to him.
steps.full_ru: Направляйтесь к Ice Cave: от Rachel на 1 карту вправо и на 3 карты вверх. Поговорите с Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245, 325). Он попытается убить вас: вы потеряете половину HP, но выживете. Вы оба поймёте, что вас подставил Vincent; вернитесь поговорить с ним.
steps.original_instruction: Head to the Ice Cave (1 map right, 3 maps up from Rachel ,) and talk to the Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245, 325). He attempts to kill you (You lose half your HP), but fails. You both then realize Vincent set you up, and you go back to talk to him.
steps.short_en: Talk to Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245, 325); lose half your HP. Return to Vincent.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Suspicious Man (ra_fild01 245, 325); потеряете половину HP. Вернитесь к Vincent.

steps.full_en: Talk to Vincent, and he explains about his situation, and that Jenny is Phobe's mother, but he can't marry her since there's an inherent class difference in the city. You offer to find his son and the jewel that was stolen.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Vincent. Он расскажет, что Jenny — мать Phobe, но он не может жениться на ней из-за классового неравенства в городе. Вы предложите найти его сына и украденную драгоценность.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Vincent, and he explains about his situation, and that Jenny is Phobe's mother, but he can't marry her since there's an inherent class difference in the city. You offer to find his son and the jewel that was stolen.
steps.short_en: Talk to Vincent and offer to find his son and the jewel.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Vincent и согласитесь найти сына и драгоценность.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Kid at (rachel 263, 32, the lower-right corner of the map, not the Kid right next to the pond) and you find out he's Phobe and took the jewel himself. You can't get him to come home, but you get the jewel.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Kid в (rachel 263, 32), в нижнем правом углу карты, а не с Kid у пруда. Вы узнаете, что это Phobe и что драгоценность взял он сам. Уговорить его вернуться домой не получится, но драгоценность вы получите.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Kid at (rachel 263, 32, the lower-right corner of the map, not the Kid right next to the pond) and you find out he's Phobe and took the jewel himself. You can't get him to come home, but you get the jewel.
steps.short_en: Find Kid / Phobe at rachel 263, 32, not beside the pond; receive the jewel.
steps.short_ru: Найдите Kid / Phobe в rachel 263, 32, не у пруда; получите драгоценность.

step_actions.condition_text: Stolen jewel; actual inventory item name/ID unknown.

steps.full_en: Take the jewel back to Vincent, and he's very thankful and asks you to tell Jenny about Phobe.
steps.full_ru: Отнесите драгоценность Vincent. Он поблагодарит вас и попросит рассказать Jenny о Phobe.
steps.original_instruction: Take the jewel back to Vincent, and he's very thankful and asks you to tell Jenny about Phobe.
steps.short_en: Bring the jewel back to Vincent.
steps.short_ru: Отнесите драгоценность Vincent.

step_actions.condition_text: The jewel from step 9, exact item identity unspecified.

steps.full_en: Talk to Jenny, and she's happy to hear you found him, and is okay with you knowing about their secret.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Jenny. Она рада, что вы нашли его, и не возражает, что вы знаете их тайну.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Jenny, and she's happy to hear you found him, and is okay with you knowing about their secret.
steps.short_en: Tell Jenny you found the child.
steps.short_ru: Сообщите Jenny, что нашли ребёнка.

steps.full_en: Go back and talk to Vincent, who rewards you with an Old Purple Box , and gives you a letter of recommendation to take to Sir Zhed, the high priest at the temple. | NOTE : If 10,000 donations for the sanctuary had already been made, players must complete steps 1 through 5 of the Rachel Sanctuary Quest .
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Vincent. Он наградит вас Old Purple Box и выдаст рекомендательное письмо для Sir Zhed, верховного жреца в храме. Примечание: если для святилища уже внесены 10,000 пожертвований, нужно сначала завершить этапы с 1 по 5 Rachel Sanctuary Quest.
steps.original_instruction: Go back and talk to Vincent, who rewards you with an Old Purple Box , and gives you a letter of recommendation to take to Sir Zhed, the high priest at the temple. | NOTE : If 10,000 donations for the sanctuary had already been made, players must complete steps 1 through 5 of the Rachel Sanctuary Quest .
steps.short_en: Return to Vincent for Old Purple Box and a letter; after 10,000 donations, Rachel Sanctuary Quest steps 1–5 are required.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Vincent за Old Purple Box и письмом; при 10,000 пожертвований нужны этапы 1–5 Rachel Sanctuary Quest.

steps.full_en: Go into the temple, and find High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277, 159) on the east side of the first floor, and give him your letter. You explain the situation, and he gives you some Base Experience.
steps.full_ru: Войдите в храм и найдите High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277, 159) в восточной части первого этажа. Передайте ему письмо и объясните ситуацию; он даст вам Base Experience.
steps.original_instruction: Go into the temple, and find High Priest Zhed (ra_temin 277, 159) on the east side of the first floor, and give him your letter. You explain the situation, and he gives you some Base Experience.
steps.short_en: Deliver the letter to High Priest Zhed: ra_temin 277, 159.
steps.short_ru: Передайте письмо High Priest Zhed: ra_temin 277, 159.

step_actions.condition_text: Recommendation letter from Vincent.

steps.full_en: Go to the house in Hugel (hugel 153 153)[take a left after you exit the airship , there should be a bridge directly in front] and proceed to the second floor. Speak to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387 245) and he shall be talking about his son and lack of medication. He will request to demand his son to go get medicine for him. (Memorizing the name of the medicine is not required)
steps.full_ru: Войдите в дом Hugel (hugel 153 153): выйдя из airship, поверните налево перед мостом. На втором этаже поговорите с Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387 245). Он жалуется на отсутствие сына и лекарств и попросит отправить сына за лекарством. Название лекарства запоминать не требуется.
steps.original_instruction: Go to the house in Hugel (hugel 153 153)[take a left after you exit the airship , there should be a bridge directly in front] and proceed to the second floor. Speak to Allen Schuwell (hu_in01 387 245) and he shall be talking about his son and lack of medication. He will request to demand his son to go get medicine for him. (Memorizing the name of the medicine is not required)
steps.short_en: Find Allen Schuwell: hugel 153 153 → hu_in01 387 245.
steps.short_ru: Найдите Allen Schuwell: hugel 153 153 → hu_in01 387 245.

steps.full_en: Postell Schuwell in the map south of Hugel (hu_fild06 34 123)[at the West portal] will then go get the medicine once he is told that his father needs him. However, he requests that his father be watched over during his absence.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Postell Schuwell к югу от Hugel, у западного портала (hu_fild06 34 123). Узнав о состоянии отца, он уйдёт за лекарством и попросит присмотреть за ним.
steps.original_instruction: Postell Schuwell in the map south of Hugel (hu_fild06 34 123)[at the West portal] will then go get the medicine once he is told that his father needs him. However, he requests that his father be watched over during his absence.
steps.short_en: Send Postell Schuwell for medicine: hu_fild06 34 123.
steps.short_ru: Отправьте Postell Schuwell за лекарством: hu_fild06 34 123.

steps.full_en: Return to Allen and he shall complain some more about his pains. He will then request a White Potion . After receiving the White Potion , he will request that you remain by his side until Postell returns.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Allen. Он попросит White Potion. Передайте её и оставайтесь рядом, пока Postell не вернётся.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Allen and he shall complain some more about his pains. He will then request a White Potion . After receiving the White Potion , he will request that you remain by his side until Postell returns.
steps.short_en: Give Allen White Potion and stay nearby until Postell returns.
steps.short_ru: Передайте Allen White Potion и останьтесь рядом до возвращения Postell.

step_items.condition_text: Single explicit potion from the consumed-item header; later story medicines are not extra White Potion charges.

steps.full_en: Speak to Allen again and he will talk about having another attack and request that you look for his medicine drawer.
steps.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Allen. При новом приступе он попросит найти ящик с лекарствами.
steps.original_instruction: Speak to Allen again and he will talk about having another attack and request that you look for his medicine drawer.
steps.short_en: Talk to Allen and find the medicine drawer.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Allen и найдите ящик с лекарствами.

steps.full_en: Step on tile to the left of you at the drawer with the axe and pick (hu_in 372 254).
steps.full_ru: Встаньте на клетку слева, у ящика с топором и киркой (hu_in 372 254).
steps.original_instruction: Step on tile to the left of you at the drawer with the axe and pick (hu_in 372 254).
steps.short_en: Stand at the drawer: hu_in 372 254.
steps.short_ru: Встаньте у ящика: hu_in 372 254.

steps.full_en: Return to Allen and go next to him and he'll ask for his medicine (Do not click on him).
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Allen и встаньте рядом: он попросит лекарство. Не нажимайте на него.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Allen and go next to him and he'll ask for his medicine (Do not click on him).
steps.short_en: Approach Allen without clicking the NPC.
steps.short_ru: Подойдите к Allen без нажатия на NPC.

step_actions.condition_text: Do not click; proximity advances this source stage.

steps.full_en: Stand on the tile by the drawer again. A dialog about medicines in the drawer should appear.
steps.full_ru: Снова встаньте на клетку у ящика. Должен появиться диалог о лекарствах внутри.
steps.original_instruction: Stand on the tile by the drawer again. A dialog about medicines in the drawer should appear.
steps.short_en: Stand at the drawer again to trigger the medicine dialogue.
steps.short_ru: Снова встаньте у ящика для диалога о лекарствах.

step_locations.condition_text: Same source drawer tile, retaining the unconfirmed map spelling.

Repeat the paired steps 6 and 7 two more times, with extra attempts if the flash deadline is missed.

steps.full_en: Repeat 6 and 7 two more times and give Allen his medicine. You must reach the drawer before the flash appears, otherwise you need to repeat 6 & 7 until you get the medicine.
steps.full_ru: Повторите этапы 6 и 7 ещё два раза и дайте Allen лекарство. Нужно добраться до ящика до появления вспышки; иначе повторяйте 6 и 7, пока не получите лекарство.
steps.original_instruction: Repeat 6 and 7 two more times and give Allen his medicine. You must reach the drawer before the flash appears, otherwise you need to repeat 6 & 7 until you get the medicine.
steps.short_en: Repeat steps 6 and 7; reach the drawer before the flash and give Allen the medicine.
steps.short_ru: Повторяйте этапы 6 и 7; успейте к ящику до вспышки и дайте Allen лекарство.

step_actions.condition_text: No named inventory item or per-cycle quantity is stated.

action_reuse.condition_text: Repeat source step 8 for the additional medicine request; inventory consumption remains unspecified.

steps.full_en: Speak to Allen a few more times (one of which requires standing near Allen). He will request for CPR and another dose of medicine. Repeat step 8. This time, a dialog about the Renkenbar experiments and side effects should appear.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Allen ещё несколько раз; один разговор требует встать рядом. Он попросит CPR и ещё лекарство. Повторите этап 8. Должен появиться диалог об экспериментах Renkenbar и побочных эффектах.
steps.original_instruction: Speak to Allen a few more times (one of which requires standing near Allen). He will request for CPR and another dose of medicine. Repeat step 8. This time, a dialog about the Renkenbar experiments and side effects should appear.
steps.short_en: Follow Allen’s CPR request and repeat step 8 until the Renkenbar dialogue.
steps.short_ru: Выполните просьбы Allen о CPR и повторите этап 8 до диалога о Renkenbar.

action_reuse.condition_text: Repeat until the random source progression advances; no fixed count is known.

steps.full_en: Repeat step 9 a few times (the number of times is random).
steps.full_ru: Повторите этап 9 несколько раз. Число повторений случайно.
steps.original_instruction: Repeat step 9 a few times (the number of times is random).
steps.short_en: Repeat step 9; the number of repetitions is random.
steps.short_ru: Повторяйте этап 9; число повторений случайно.

steps.full_en: After a certain point, Allen will complain about his pain instead of requesting CPR and Postell shall appear. Postell apparently got the wrong medicine and will then leave again. Allen will then tell you to return to the medicine drawer.
steps.full_ru: В какой-то момент Allen пожалуется на боль вместо просьбы о CPR, и появится Postell. Он принесёт неверное лекарство и снова уйдёт. Allen направит обратно к ящику.
steps.original_instruction: After a certain point, Allen will complain about his pain instead of requesting CPR and Postell shall appear. Postell apparently got the wrong medicine and will then leave again. Allen will then tell you to return to the medicine drawer.
steps.short_en: Wait for Postell to appear, then return to the drawer at Allen’s request.
steps.short_ru: Дождитесь появления Postell, затем по просьбе Allen вернитесь к ящику.

steps.full_en: Receive 50,000 Base EXP and an Old Blue Box .
steps.full_ru: Получите 50,000 Base EXP и Old Blue Box.
steps.original_instruction: Receive 50,000 Base EXP and an Old Blue Box .
steps.short_en: Receive 50,000 Base EXP and Old Blue Box.
steps.short_ru: Получите 50,000 Base EXP и Old Blue Box.

rewards.condition_text: Nameless Island night map after leaving the house.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Agent on the lower level of the International Airship . He tells you to go visit Father Bamph in the Prontera Church.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Agent на нижнем уровне International Airship. Он направит вас к Father Bamph в церкви Prontera.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Agent on the lower level of the International Airship . He tells you to go visit Father Bamph in the Prontera Church.
steps.short_en: Talk to Agent on the lower level of International Airship.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Agent на нижнем уровне International Airship.

steps.full_en: Meet with Father Bamph in Prontera. He tells you to meet with a contact in the Comodo Casino by the name of Larjes concerning a missing Midgard official.
steps.full_ru: Найдите Father Bamph в Prontera. Он отправит вас к контакту по имени Larjes в Comodo Casino по делу пропавшего чиновника Midgard.
steps.original_instruction: Meet with Father Bamph in Prontera. He tells you to meet with a contact in the Comodo Casino by the name of Larjes concerning a missing Midgard official.
steps.short_en: Talk to Father Bamph in Prontera about meeting Larjes.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Father Bamph в Prontera о встрече с Larjes.

steps.full_en: On the first floor (lower level) of the Comodo Casino (comodo 140, 115) you'll see an "Ordinary Man" (cmd_in02 174, 89). After talking to him he will pull you aside to talk. Talk to him once more, and he'll ask you to return to Father Bamph.
steps.full_ru: На первом, нижнем этаже Comodo Casino (comodo 140, 115) найдите «Ordinary Man» (cmd_in02 174, 89). После разговора он отведёт вас в сторону. Поговорите ещё раз: он попросит вернуться к Father Bamph.
steps.original_instruction: On the first floor (lower level) of the Comodo Casino (comodo 140, 115) you'll see an "Ordinary Man" (cmd_in02 174, 89). After talking to him he will pull you aside to talk. Talk to him once more, and he'll ask you to return to Father Bamph.
steps.short_en: Talk to Ordinary Man twice: cmd_in02 174, 89.
steps.short_ru: Дважды поговорите с Ordinary Man: cmd_in02 174, 89.

step_actions.condition_text: Talk again after he pulls you aside.

steps.full_en: Return to Father Bamph. Keep talking to him until he makes up his mind about what to do. He ask for your help, and send you to Rachel to investigate.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Father Bamph. Продолжайте говорить с ним, пока он не решит, что делать. Он попросит помощи и отправит расследовать в Rachel.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Father Bamph. Keep talking to him until he makes up his mind about what to do. He ask for your help, and send you to Rachel to investigate.
steps.short_en: Keep talking to Father Bamph until sent to Rachel.
steps.short_ru: Говорите с Father Bamph до направления в Rachel.

step_actions.condition_text: Repeat until sent to Rachel.

steps.full_en: In the Rachel Inn (rachel 115, 147), talk to the Waiter (ra_in01 308, 59) and tell him you wish to order. You will overhear a conversation concerning a famous "fish" caught near Veins . After the conversation you will spend 3000 Zeny (if you have it) and obtain 4 Assorted Seafood .
steps.full_ru: В гостинице Rachel (rachel 115, 147) поговорите с Waiter (ra_in01 308, 59) и скажите, что хотите заказать еду. Вы услышите разговор о знаменитой «рыбе», пойманной рядом с Veins. После разговора вы потратите 3000 Zeny, если они у вас есть, и получите 4 Assorted Seafood.
steps.original_instruction: In the Rachel Inn (rachel 115, 147), talk to the Waiter (ra_in01 308, 59) and tell him you wish to order. You will overhear a conversation concerning a famous "fish" caught near Veins . After the conversation you will spend 3000 Zeny (if you have it) and obtain 4 Assorted Seafood .

steps.full_en: Proceed to Veins and in a building on the left end of the city (veins 86, 170), talk to the Magistrate by the name of Al Hamad. Ask him if he's in trouble. When he gives you the brushoff, talk to the guard by the door, and then come back and question Al Hamad further. He will tell you that you need a written order from a high ranking official in order to divulge information.

steps.full_en: Go to High Priest Zhed in the Rachel Sanctuary. Note that you must have completed the Veins Siblings Quest in order to advance further.

steps.full_en: Go to the Veins tavern (veins 149, 217) and speak to the first Drunkard. He babbles about his fishing boat.
steps.full_ru: В таверне Veins (veins 149, 217) поговорите с первым Drunkard: он рассказывает о своей рыбацкой лодке.

steps.full_ru: Поговорите с его сыном Karyn (veins 327, 185), которому помогали в Veins Siblings Quest. Он разрешит воспользоваться отцовской лодкой для поездки к монастырю.

steps.full_ru: Южнее Veins найдите лодку (ve_fild07 128, 131). При осмотре вас встретит Larjes. Поговорите с Larjes или воспользуйтесь лодкой для поездки на Nameless Island.

steps.full_en: You'll need to investigate the island. There are triggers just west of the docks and inside a house near the top center, but these are not required. To continue, click on the Dead Crow (nameless_i 125,205) and investigate it.
steps.full_ru: Исследуйте остров. События западнее причала и в доме около верхней центральной части необязательны. Для продолжения нажмите Dead Crow (nameless_i 125,205) и осмотрите его.

steps.short_en: Investigate Dead Crow: nameless_i 125,205.
steps.short_ru: Осмотрите Dead Crow: nameless_i 125,205.

steps.full_en: Once you wake up, you'll find yourself inside a house with Larjes. When you attempt to leave the house, you'll be attacked by a Zombie Slaughter. The monster must be killed before the house can be exited. There is no death penalty if you die at this encounter. After you leave the house, you will be able to freely enter and leave Nameless Island night map. | Note: Once you leave the house, you will be on the Nameless Island (Night) map, where there are numerous aggressive monsters. You will lose experience if you die here. | If you die inside the house while trying to kill the Zombie Slaughter, you will respawn. If this happens, just go back to Nameless Island and enter the first house on the north path. Be cautious because when you enter the Zombie Slaughter will attack you without warning this time.
steps.full_ru: Очнувшись, вы окажетесь в доме с Larjes. При попытке выйти нападёт Zombie Slaughter: убейте его, чтобы выйти. В этом бою внутри дома штрафа за смерть нет. После выхода станет доступно свободное посещение ночной карты Nameless Island. Примечание: снаружи, на Nameless Island (Night), много агрессивных монстров и за смерть теряется опыт. При смерти от Zombie Slaughter внутри дома вы возродитесь; вернитесь на Nameless Island и войдите в первый дом на северной тропе. При повторном входе Zombie Slaughter нападёт сразу.

You will lose experience if you die here. | If you die inside the house while trying to kill the Zombie Slaughter, you will respawn. If this happens, just go back to Nameless Island and enter the first house on the north path. Be cautious because when you enter the Zombie Slaughter will attack you without warning this time.
steps.short_en: Kill Zombie Slaughter inside the house; death has no penalty inside, but does outside.
steps.short_ru: Убейте Zombie Slaughter в доме; штрафа за смерть внутри нет, снаружи он действует.

step_monsters.condition_text: Must die before leaving this house; no death penalty applies only to this encounter.

steps.full_en: Following up with your investigation, you will have to make your way to floor 2 of the Monastery and investigate the Books on a desk in Hibram's quarters (abbey02 223,68).

steps.short_ru: Осмотрите Books: abbey02 223,68, этаж 2 Monastery.

steps.full_en: Continue to floor 3 of the Monastery. In the top right most corner of the map in a prison cell you will find a Man collapsed on the ground. When you investigate the body, you will be attacked by the King's Corpse . This battle is fairly easy, if you can kill the regular monsters in the monestary you should be able to kill him.
steps.full_ru: Поднимитесь на этаж 3 Monastery. В тюремной камере в самом верхнем правом углу найдите Man, лежащего на земле. Осмотрите тело: нападёт King's Corpse. По оценке источника, если вы справляетесь с обычными монстрами монастыря, этот бой также должен быть посилен.

steps.short_en: Inspect Man on Monastery floor 3 and defeat King's Corpse.
steps.short_ru: Осмотрите Man на этаже 3 Monastery и победите King's Corpse.

steps.full_en: Go to the third map ( odin_tem03 ) of the Shrine, and visit the following locations (one of the warps will work, but you may not need to visit them all): | (288,271) | (266,302) | (321,263) | (179,275) | (283,241) One of them will warp you to an Underground Shrine. Walk down the path and you find some ruins. Walk around, and windows will pop up telling you you've walked past some object. Choose "Explore" until you find one that works, and a hammer will whack you on the head. When you come to, you'll find the ruins have vanished. Walk back up, and you'll be warped back to the island (But not necessarily the place you got warped from).
steps.full_ru: На третьей карте Shrine (odin_tem03) проверьте точки (288,271), (266,302), (321,263), (179,275), (283,241). Сработает одна из них; посещать все необязательно. Вас перенесёт в Underground Shrine. Пройдите вниз к руинам и перемещайтесь рядом с объектами, вызывая окна диалогов. Выбирайте «Explore», пока не сработает подходящий объект: вас ударит молот. Очнувшись, вы обнаружите, что руины исчезли. Поднимитесь обратно: вас перенесёт на остров, возможно в другую точку.

Walk down the path and you find some ruins. Walk around, and windows will pop up telling you you've walked past some object. Choose "Explore" until you find one that works, and a hammer will whack you on the head. When you come to, you'll find the ruins have vanished. Walk back up, and you'll be warped back to the island (But not necessarily the place you got warped from).

steps.short_ru: На odin_tem03 найдите работающую точку переноса, затем выбирайте «Explore» у руин.

steps.full_en: Go back to Sikaiz, who registers you and sends you to talk to some Officers to let them know of your departure. Go downstairs to the banquet hall (147, 179) and talk to them, but first you overhear them plotting to ignore the peace and take control of things for themselves.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Sikaiz. Он зарегистрирует вас и попросит уведомить Officers об отправлении. Спуститесь в банкетный зал (147, 179). Перед разговором вы подслушаете их планы нарушить мир и захватить власть.
steps.original_instruction: Go back to Sikaiz, who registers you and sends you to talk to some Officers to let them know of your departure. Go downstairs to the banquet hall (147, 179) and talk to them, but first you overhear them plotting to ignore the peace and take control of things for themselves.
steps.short_en: Finish registration with Sikaiz, then overhear Officers downstairs (147, 179).
steps.short_ru: У Sikaiz завершите регистрацию, затем подслушайте Officers внизу (147, 179).

steps.full_en: Report back upstairs, but the guards won't let you in. Walk to (148, 257), where you're able to overhear Munkenro talking to someone.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь наверх с докладом, но стражники не пропустят. Подойдите к (148, 257), чтобы подслушать разговор Munkenro.
steps.original_instruction: Report back upstairs, but the guards won't let you in. Walk to (148, 257), where you're able to overhear Munkenro talking to someone.
steps.short_en: Overhear Munkenro at (148, 257).
steps.short_ru: Подслушайте Munkenro у (148, 257).

steps.full_en: Talk to the Guard outside of the lecture hall (lhz_in01 130, 231). Ask it to teleport you immediately to the Continental Guard Quarantine (moc_fild20), and talk to the Rift Guard ( moc_fild20 349, 179). He takes you to the Dimensional Gorge.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Guard у лекционного зала (lhz_in01 130, 231). Попросите сразу перенести в Continental Guard Quarantine (moc_fild20). Там поговорите с Rift Guard (moc_fild20 349, 179): он отправит в Dimensional Gorge.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Guard outside of the lecture hall (lhz_in01 130, 231). Ask it to teleport you immediately to the Continental Guard Quarantine (moc_fild20), and talk to the Rift Guard ( moc_fild20 349, 179). He takes you to the Dimensional Gorge.
steps.short_en: Ask Guard (lhz_in01 130, 231) for transport, then talk to Rift Guard (moc_fild20 349, 179).
steps.short_ru: У Guard (lhz_in01 130, 231) запросите перенос, затем поговорите с Rift Guard (moc_fild20 349, 179).

steps.full_en: From the middle of the right side of the map, go towards the center until you reach Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230, 197). He says Sikaiz has "retired" and that he is now the alliance leader. He also requires you to pass another test, by defeating 50 Mobsters .
steps.full_ru: От середины правой стороны карты идите к центру до Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230, 197). Он заявит, что Sikaiz «retired», а новым лидером стал он сам. Для ещё одного испытания победите 50 Mobsters.
steps.original_instruction: From the middle of the right side of the map, go towards the center until you reach Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230, 197). He says Sikaiz has "retired" and that he is now the alliance leader. He also requires you to pass another test, by defeating 50 Mobsters .
steps.short_en: Get the trial from Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230, 197): defeat 50 Mobsters.
steps.short_ru: У Munkenro (moc_fild22b 230, 197) получите испытание: победить 50 Mobsters.

steps.full_en: After passing the test, talk to Munkenro again, who sends you to the Ash-Vacuum. Receive 660,000 Base EXP Receive 210,000 Job EXP | Note: To ensure you can travel around in the New World, start New Surroundings and Attitude to the New World .
steps.full_ru: После испытания снова поговорите с Munkenro: он отправит вас в Ash-Vacuum. Получите 660,000 Base EXP и 210,000 Job EXP. Примечание: чтобы свободно перемещаться по New World, начните New Surroundings и Attitude to the New World.
steps.original_instruction: After passing the test, talk to Munkenro again, who sends you to the Ash-Vacuum. Receive 660,000 Base EXP Receive 210,000 Job EXP | Note: To ensure you can travel around in the New World, start New Surroundings and Attitude to the New World .
steps.short_en: Complete the trial with Munkenro: 660,000 Base EXP, 210,000 Job EXP and Ash-Vacuum access.
steps.short_ru: Завершите испытание у Munkenro: 660,000 Base EXP, 210,000 Job EXP и доступ в Ash-Vacuum.

dialogue_options.condition_text: Either choice continues the same quest.
Either choice continues the same quest.

rewards.condition_text: Header total across the two unspecified installments at stages 20 and 21; not an additional grant.
First installment; amount unknown. Do not assign the entire header total here.
Second installment; amount unknown. Header total is not a third grant.

steps.full_en: At the Morroc Ruins (one map NW from Morroc) talk to the Foreign Merchant (moc_ruins 77,167) in the NW corner of the map. He complains about how hot the town is and says he may be leaving soon, and asks if there's a place to grab a drink in town. Talk to him twice and he will suggest a merchant at the oasis.
steps.full_ru: В Morroc Ruins, на одну карту к NW от Morroc, дважды поговорите с Foreign Merchant (moc_ruins 77,167) в северо-западном углу. Он жалуется на жару, собирается уехать и спрашивает, где выпить. После второго разговора он предложит найти торговца у оазиса.
steps.original_instruction: At the Morroc Ruins (one map NW from Morroc) talk to the Foreign Merchant (moc_ruins 77,167) in the NW corner of the map. He complains about how hot the town is and says he may be leaving soon, and asks if there's a place to grab a drink in town. Talk to him twice and he will suggest a merchant at the oasis.
steps.short_en: Talk twice to Foreign Merchant: moc_ruins 77,167.
steps.short_ru: Дважды поговорите с Foreign Merchant: moc_ruins 77,167.

steps.full_en: Next, walk around the perimeter of the oasis in the center of the map to trigger the next NPC . After a couple of trips around, he should appear at (moc_ruins 101,133), in between the Cool Corp. and Kafra voting staff NPCs.
steps.full_ru: Обойдите периметр оазиса в центре карты, чтобы вызвать следующего NPC. Через пару кругов он должен появиться в точке moc_ruins 101,133, между сотрудниками голосования Cool Corp. и Kafra.
steps.original_instruction: Next, walk around the perimeter of the oasis in the center of the map to trigger the next NPC . After a couple of trips around, he should appear at (moc_ruins 101,133), in between the Cool Corp. and Kafra voting staff NPCs.
steps.short_en: Walk around the oasis until the merchant appears: moc_ruins 101,133.
steps.short_ru: Обходите оазис до появления торговца: moc_ruins 101,133.

step_actions.condition_text: A couple of trips is descriptive; no exact count, timer or guaranteed loop number.

steps.full_en: Talk to the new Foreign Merchant, who says he's out of wine, but manages to scrounge up a bottle for you to give to the thirsty man.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с новым Foreign Merchant. Хотя вино у него закончилось, он найдёт bottle, чтобы вы передали её страдающему от жажды мужчине.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the new Foreign Merchant, who says he's out of wine, but manages to scrounge up a bottle for you to give to the thirsty man.
steps.short_en: Collect the bottle from Foreign Merchant at the oasis.
steps.short_ru: Получите bottle у Foreign Merchant возле оазиса.

step_items.condition_text: Story bottle; inventory ID and count are not established.

steps.full_en: Return to the first Foreign Merchant, who is thankful for the drink. For some reason, he also knows your name--he's an agent of High Priest Zhed from the Rachel Sanctuary Quest .
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к первому Foreign Merchant с напитком. Он поблагодарит вас и окажется агентом High Priest Zhed из Rachel Sanctuary Quest; поэтому он знает ваше имя.
steps.original_instruction: Return to the first Foreign Merchant, who is thankful for the drink. For some reason, he also knows your name--he's an agent of High Priest Zhed from the Rachel Sanctuary Quest .
steps.short_en: Return with the drink to the first Foreign Merchant.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь с напитком к первому Foreign Merchant.

step_items.condition_text: The bottle from the oasis merchant; no second grant or numeric count is inferred.

steps.full_en: Head to Rachel , and talk to High Priest Zhed in the Sanctuary (ra_temin 277, 159). He explains how he's lost control of the other priests, and belives the young Pope is too inexperienced to do her job. He wants to help her, but needs your help to convince her to let him assist her. He feels telling her the complete truth is the best course of action. However, you must choose whether or not to "sugar coat" it to her. It's not relevant if you choose "Truth" or "Lies", the quests follows the same way.
steps.full_ru: В Rachel поговорите с High Priest Zhed в Sanctuary (ra_temin 277, 159). Он потерял влияние на остальных жрецов и считает молодую Pope неопытной. Он хочет помочь ей и просит вашей поддержки. Можно выбрать «Truth» или «Lies»: оба ответа ведут к одному продолжению, несмотря на вопрос о том, стоит ли смягчать правду.
steps.original_instruction: Head to Rachel , and talk to High Priest Zhed in the Sanctuary (ra_temin 277, 159). He explains how he's lost control of the other priests, and belives the young Pope is too inexperienced to do her job. He wants to help her, but needs your help to convince her to let him assist her. He feels telling her the complete truth is the best course of action. However, you must choose whether or not to "sugar coat" it to her. It's not relevant if you choose "Truth" or "Lies", the quests follows the same way.
steps.short_en: Talk to High Priest Zhed: ra_temin 277, 159; “Truth” and “Lies” lead onward equally.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с High Priest Zhed: ra_temin 277, 159; «Truth» и «Lies» равнозначны.

steps.full_en: Zhed tells you about his close friend, High Priest Niren, and asks that you go talk to her.
steps.full_ru: Zhed расскажет о близкой подруге High Priest Niren и попросит поговорить с ней.
steps.original_instruction: Zhed tells you about his close friend, High Priest Niren, and asks that you go talk to her.
steps.short_en: Listen to Zhed and receive the request to find High Priest Niren.
steps.short_ru: Выслушайте Zhed и получите поручение найти High Priest Niren.

steps.full_en: Inside the sanctuary still, go to the left side, and talk to the Female Follower (ra_temin 103, 151). She says you can find Niren outside in the garden.
steps.full_ru: Оставаясь внутри Sanctuary, пройдите в левую часть и поговорите с Female Follower (ra_temin 103, 151). Она скажет, что Niren находится снаружи, в саду.
steps.original_instruction: Inside the sanctuary still, go to the left side, and talk to the Female Follower (ra_temin 103, 151). She says you can find Niren outside in the garden.
steps.short_en: Ask Female Follower about Niren: ra_temin 103, 151.
steps.short_ru: Спросите Female Follower о Niren: ra_temin 103, 151.

steps.full_en: Talk to Niren (ra_temple 165, 57), and ask about Zhed. She refuses to help him, and says she wants a war.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Niren (ra_temple 165, 57) и спросите о Zhed. Она откажется помогать ему и заявит, что хочет войны.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Niren (ra_temple 165, 57), and ask about Zhed. She refuses to help him, and says she wants a war.
steps.short_en: Ask Niren about Zhed: ra_temple 165, 57.
steps.short_ru: Спросите Niren о Zhed: ra_temple 165, 57.

steps.full_en: Return to Zhed, and explain Niren's feelings to him. He writes you a note to give to her to explain himself better and gives it to you to deliver to her.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Zhed и расскажите о настроении Niren. Он напишет note с объяснениями и передаст её вам для доставки Niren.
steps.original_instruction: Return to Zhed, and explain Niren's feelings to him. He writes you a note to give to her to explain himself better and gives it to you to deliver to her.
steps.short_en: Collect the note from Zhed for Niren.
steps.short_ru: Заберите note у Zhed для Niren.

step_items.condition_text: Personal note from Zhed; distinct from the later forgery File.

steps.full_en: Deliver the note to Niren, and she seems to be symathetic to Zhed. She asks you to wait a bit so she can think about what to do.
steps.full_ru: Доставьте note Niren. Она отнесётся к объяснениям Zhed сочувственно и попросит немного подождать, пока обдумает дальнейшие действия.
steps.original_instruction: Deliver the note to Niren, and she seems to be symathetic to Zhed. She asks you to wait a bit so she can think about what to do.
steps.short_en: Deliver the note to Niren and wait for the conversation to continue.
steps.short_ru: Передайте note Niren и дождитесь продолжения.

steps.full_en: Talk to her again until she continues (it may take a few tries), who says she'll give Zhed another try, and tells you to go visit the Pope.
steps.full_ru: Снова говорите с ней, пока разговор не продолжится; может потребоваться несколько попыток. Она даст Zhed ещё один шанс и попросит посетить Pope.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to her again until she continues (it may take a few tries), who says she'll give Zhed another try, and tells you to go visit the Pope.
steps.short_en: Keep talking to Niren until she sends you to Pope.
steps.short_ru: Повторяйте разговор с Niren, пока она не отправит к Pope.

step_actions.condition_text: Source gives no exact wait duration or conversation count.

steps.full_en: Go back into the Sanctuary, and head to the Pope's Office (ra_temin 132, 131). Talk to the Pope, and she's apparently feeling lonely and tired.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в Sanctuary и войдите в Pope's Office (ra_temin 132, 131). Поговорите с Pope: она чувствует себя одинокой и уставшей.
steps.original_instruction: Go back into the Sanctuary, and head to the Pope's Office (ra_temin 132, 131). Talk to the Pope, and she's apparently feeling lonely and tired.
steps.short_en: Talk to Pope in Pope's Office: ra_temin 132, 131.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Pope в Pope's Office: ra_temin 132, 131.

steps.full_en: Go back to Niren, and tell her about the situation with the Pope. Unfortunately, the priests are with her day and night, so Niren comes up with a way to get them all to leave. She writes a note for you to give to a forger who'll come up with something to give all the other priests some vacation.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Niren и расскажите о состоянии Pope. Жрецы находятся с ней день и ночь, поэтому Niren придумает способ отправить их в отпуск. Она напишет note, которую нужно передать мастеру подделок.
steps.original_instruction: Go back to Niren, and tell her about the situation with the Pope. Unfortunately, the priests are with her day and night, so Niren comes up with a way to get them all to leave. She writes a note for you to give to a forger who'll come up with something to give all the other priests some vacation.
steps.short_en: Collect the note for the forger from Niren.
steps.short_ru: Получите у Niren note для мастера подделок.

step_items.condition_text: Stage 14 explicitly calls the document received from Niren File; this is not Zhed's earlier personal note.

steps.full_en: Head to Rachel Field 3 (2 maps directly north of Rachel), and talk to Ishmael (top center-left of the map) at (139, 355). Give her the File you got from Niren, but Ishmael needs a Sardonyx to finish the note because her pen broke.
steps.full_ru: Идите в Rachel Field 3, на 2 карты прямо к северу от Rachel. Поговорите с Ishmael в верхней части карты, немного левее центра (139, 355). Передайте File от Niren. Для завершения note ей нужен Sardonyx, поскольку её ручка сломалась.
steps.original_instruction: Head to Rachel Field 3 (2 maps directly north of Rachel), and talk to Ishmael (top center-left of the map) at (139, 355). Give her the File you got from Niren, but Ishmael needs a Sardonyx to finish the note because her pen broke.
steps.short_en: Deliver File to Ishmael in Rachel Field 3 (139, 355); she needs Sardonyx.
steps.short_ru: Передайте File Ishmael в Rachel Field 3 (139, 355); ей нужен Sardonyx.

step_items.condition_text: Single header material; requested here, supplied in stage 15. Not a second cost.

steps.full_en: Once you have a Sardonx, talk to Ishmael again, and she completes the forgery, then hands back another File.
steps.full_ru: Когда у вас будет Sardonx (именно такое написание в тексте этапа), снова поговорите с Ishmael. Она завершит подделку и вернёт другой File.
steps.original_instruction: Once you have a Sardonx, talk to Ishmael again, and she completes the forgery, then hands back another File.
steps.short_en: Return to Ishmael with the requested gem and collect the forged File.
steps.short_ru: Вернитесь к Ishmael с запрошенным камнем и заберите поддельный File.

step_items.condition_text: Another File, replacing the original forgery request; distinct document identity.
Header and stage 14 say Sardonyx; stage 15 says Sardonx. Link this one source-requested gem to the header ID, without treating the typo label as independently verified.

steps.full_en: Return the File to Niren, who gives it to her assistant to deliver. She tells you go to get Zhed.
steps.full_ru: Верните File Niren. Она передаст его помощнику для доставки и попросит привести Zhed.
steps.original_instruction: Return the File to Niren, who gives it to her assistant to deliver. She tells you go to get Zhed.
steps.short_en: Return the forged File to Niren and go to Zhed.
steps.short_ru: Верните поддельный File Niren и отправляйтесь к Zhed.

steps.full_en: Talk to Zhed, and you tell him he and Niren can visit the Pope.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Zhed и сообщите, что он и Niren могут посетить Pope.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Zhed, and you tell him he and Niren can visit the Pope.
steps.short_en: Invite Zhed to meet Pope and Niren.
steps.short_ru: Позовите Zhed на встречу с Pope и Niren.

steps.full_en: Go back to the Pope's Office, where you see Niren and Zhed speaking with the Pope. She already knew most of what they told her, and is happy to have someone willing to help. After their conversation ends, she sends you back to Rachel.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в Pope's Office и посмотрите разговор Niren и Zhed с Pope. Она уже знала многое из сказанного и рада, что ей готовы помочь. После разговора она отправит вас обратно в Rachel.
steps.original_instruction: Go back to the Pope's Office, where you see Niren and Zhed speaking with the Pope. She already knew most of what they told her, and is happy to have someone willing to help. After their conversation ends, she sends you back to Rachel.
steps.short_en: Watch Pope, Niren and Zhed talk; you are then sent to Rachel.
steps.short_ru: Посмотрите разговор Pope, Niren и Zhed; затем вас перенесут в Rachel.

steps.full_en: The Pope now makes a speech, saying the rest of the high priests and preistesses will now be under Zhed and Niren's command.
steps.full_ru: Pope произнесёт речь: остальные верховные жрецы и жрицы теперь подчиняются Zhed и Niren.
steps.original_instruction: The Pope now makes a speech, saying the rest of the high priests and preistesses will now be under Zhed and Niren's command.
steps.short_en: Listen to the speech of Pope about Zhed and Niren.
steps.short_ru: Дождитесь речи Pope о Zhed и Niren.

steps.full_en: Talk to Niren again, who is very happy about what happened. She then says to talk to Zhed, and gives you some Base Experience.
steps.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Niren. Она рада случившемуся, даст некоторое количество Base Experience и попросит поговорить с Zhed.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Niren again, who is very happy about what happened. She then says to talk to Zhed, and gives you some Base Experience.
steps.short_en: Collect Base Experience from Niren, then go to Zhed.
steps.short_ru: Получите Base Experience у Niren, затем идите к Zhed.

steps.full_en: Talk to Zhed again, who says the Thor Volcano camp is closing down, and is glad that they're doing something to fight back against the extremist priests. He rewards you with some Base Experience.
steps.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Zhed. Он сообщит о закрытии Thor Volcano camp и порадуется противодействию радикальным жрецам. Получите ещё некоторое количество Base Experience.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to Zhed again, who says the Thor Volcano camp is closing down, and is glad that they're doing something to fight back against the extremist priests. He rewards you with some Base Experience.
steps.short_en: Talk to Zhed and receive the remaining Base Experience reward.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Zhed и получите оставшуюся награду Base Experience.

dialogue_options.condition_text: Initial prompted PIN only; the subsequent card number is not supplied by the source.

rewards.condition_text: Later distinct source grant, not duplicated from the earlier Jargeah handover.

steps.full_en: On a visit to Lighthalzen , you stumble across an Ordinary Man, Ghalstein (lighthalzen 179 170) and greet him.
steps.full_ru: Во время визита в Lighthalzen поговорите с Ordinary Man, Ghalstein (lighthalzen 179 170).
steps.original_instruction: On a visit to Lighthalzen , you stumble across an Ordinary Man, Ghalstein (lighthalzen 179 170) and greet him.
steps.short_en: Talk to Ghalstein: lighthalzen 179 170.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Ghalstein: lighthalzen 179 170.

steps.full_en: Walk close to the wall surrounding the upper left area, suddenly you overhear a conversation. You can't quite hear what they're talking about, but you hear a familiar sound... it's Ghalstein.
steps.full_ru: Подойдите к стене вокруг верхней левой области. Вы подслушаете разговор и узнаете голос Ghalstein.
steps.original_instruction: Walk close to the wall surrounding the upper left area, suddenly you overhear a conversation. You can't quite hear what they're talking about, but you hear a familiar sound... it's Ghalstein.
steps.short_en: Near the upper-left area’s wall, overhear Ghalstein’s voice.
steps.short_ru: У стены верхней левой области подслушайте голос Ghalstein.

steps.full_en: Next go talk to Ghalstein again and ask about what you just overheard, and confirm it was his voice. After trying to get it out of him, he finally admits that it was him on and he asks you to give him time to consider telling the truth.
steps.full_ru: Снова поговорите с Ghalstein и спросите о подслушанном разговоре. Убедите его признать свой голос; он попросит время, чтобы решить, рассказывать ли правду.
steps.original_instruction: Next go talk to Ghalstein again and ask about what you just overheard, and confirm it was his voice. After trying to get it out of him, he finally admits that it was him on and he asks you to give him time to consider telling the truth.
steps.short_en: Question Ghalstein about the overheard conversation.
steps.short_ru: Расспросите Ghalstein о подслушанном разговоре.

steps.full_en: He then tells you he belongs to a secret group that's fighting an underground war with someone and asks you to help them. Agree to help him. He proposes a restriction on you by making you swallow a red pill which will undoubtedly make sure you stay truthful to the cause. He assure that he'll give the antidote once you complete his mission.
steps.full_ru: Он расскажет о тайной группе, ведущей подпольную войну, и попросит помощи. Согласитесь. Для гарантии верности он заставит проглотить красную пилюлю и обещает противоядие после задания.
steps.original_instruction: He then tells you he belongs to a secret group that's fighting an underground war with someone and asks you to help them. Agree to help him. He proposes a restriction on you by making you swallow a red pill which will undoubtedly make sure you stay truthful to the cause. He assure that he'll give the antidote once you complete his mission.
steps.short_en: Agree to help and take the red pill during the dialogue.
steps.short_ru: Согласитесь помочь и примите красную пилюлю по ходу диалога.

step_actions.condition_text: Narrative action; exact menu text, inventory name and ID are not stated.

steps.full_en: Ghalstein wants you to investigate on Rekenber Headquarters because lately strange creatures have been seen under the basement. He asks for you to collect all related biological exhibits, plus the most important thing and he assure you that you'll know that important thing when I see it (Ymir's Heart Piece). He also tells you that lately people are missing in the slum area and it probably has to do with the Rekenber Corporation as well.
steps.full_ru: Ghalstein попросит исследовать Rekenber Headquarters: в подвале видели странных существ. Соберите биологические образцы и главное — Ymir's Heart Piece. Он также расскажет об исчезновениях в трущобах, возможно связанных с Rekenber Corporation.
steps.original_instruction: Ghalstein wants you to investigate on Rekenber Headquarters because lately strange creatures have been seen under the basement. He asks for you to collect all related biological exhibits, plus the most important thing and he assure you that you'll know that important thing when I see it (Ymir's Heart Piece). He also tells you that lately people are missing in the slum area and it probably has to do with the Rekenber Corporation as well.
steps.short_en: Get Ghalstein’s task to collect biological exhibits and Ymir's Heart Piece.
steps.short_ru: Получите у Ghalstein задание на образцы и Ymir's Heart Piece.

steps.full_en: Those that did the Biolabs Entrance Quest can go to Level 2 and Level 3 of the Biolabs Dungeon through the Underwater Tunnel. | Collect 10 Research Charts , 10 Handcuffs and a Ymir's Heart Piece (Top right corner of Level 2)
steps.full_ru: После Biolabs Entrance Quest можно пройти в Level 2 и Level 3 Biolabs Dungeon через Underwater Tunnel. Соберите 10 Research Charts, 10 Handcuffs и Ymir's Heart Piece в правом верхнем углу Level 2.
steps.original_instruction: Those that did the Biolabs Entrance Quest can go to Level 2 and Level 3 of the Biolabs Dungeon through the Underwater Tunnel. | Collect 10 Research Charts , 10 Handcuffs and a Ymir's Heart Piece (Top right corner of Level 2)
steps.short_en: Collect 10 Research Charts, 10 Handcuffs and Ymir's Heart Piece in Biolabs.
steps.short_ru: Соберите 10 Research Charts, 10 Handcuffs и Ymir's Heart Piece в Biolabs.

steps.full_en: After gathering the items needed, talk to Ghalstein. He asks you to meet Gushaar for the next mission somewhere around Juno . | Obtain Membership Card
steps.full_ru: Собрав материалы, поговорите с Ghalstein. Он направит к Gushaar около Juno для следующего задания. Получите Membership Card.
steps.original_instruction: After gathering the items needed, talk to Ghalstein. He asks you to meet Gushaar for the next mission somewhere around Juno . | Obtain Membership Card
steps.short_en: Give Ghalstein the materials; receive Membership Card and a referral to Gushaar.
steps.short_ru: Передайте материалы Ghalstein; получите Membership Card и направление к Gushaar.

steps.full_en: Looking somewhere around Juno, you found a Dismayed Man, Gushaar (yuno_fild04 165 245). You tell him you've been sent by Ghalstein and he asks you to chose red pill and blue pill. Since Ghalstein previously gave you red pill, choose the red pill. Then he asks if you have something to show him. Say yes, and show him the Membership Card.
steps.full_ru: Около Juno найдите Dismayed Man, Gushaar (yuno_fild04 165 245). Скажите, что вас послал Ghalstein. На вопрос о красной или синей пилюле выберите красную. Затем подтвердите, что есть что показать, и покажите Membership Card.
steps.original_instruction: Looking somewhere around Juno, you found a Dismayed Man, Gushaar (yuno_fild04 165 245). You tell him you've been sent by Ghalstein and he asks you to chose red pill and blue pill. Since Ghalstein previously gave you red pill, choose the red pill. Then he asks if you have something to show him. Say yes, and show him the Membership Card.
steps.short_en: At Gushaar (yuno_fild04 165 245), choose the red pill and show Membership Card.
steps.short_ru: У Gushaar (yuno_fild04 165 245) выберите красную пилюлю и покажите Membership Card.

step_actions.condition_text: Source paraphrases the choice; no exact quoted menu label is established.

steps.full_en: After that he tells you his country, Schwarzwald is controled by the evil Rekenber Corporation. You learn that they have organized a resistance called Wing Of Secret with the help of the President Karl Weierstrass to free the Schwarzwald Republic from the control of Rekenber. He asks you to meet the President at an appointed time. * Between 8 PM to 11 PM or 11 AM to 2 PM talk to the President's secretary. For iRO, the times listed are in Pacific Time.
steps.full_ru: Он расскажет, что Schwarzwald контролирует Rekenber Corporation, а сопротивление Wing Of Secret поддерживает President Karl Weierstrass. Встретьтесь с President в назначенное время: между 8 PM и 11 PM или между 11 AM и 2 PM поговорите с его секретарём. Для iRO указано Pacific Time.
steps.original_instruction: After that he tells you his country, Schwarzwald is controled by the evil Rekenber Corporation. You learn that they have organized a resistance called Wing Of Secret with the help of the President Karl Weierstrass to free the Schwarzwald Republic from the control of Rekenber. He asks you to meet the President at an appointed time. * Between 8 PM to 11 PM or 11 AM to 2 PM talk to the President's secretary. For iRO, the times listed are in Pacific Time.
steps.short_en: Visit the President’s secretary: 8 PM–11 PM or 11 AM–2 PM; iRO uses Pacific Time.
steps.short_ru: Посетите секретаря President: 8 PM–11 PM или 11 AM–2 PM; на iRO — Pacific Time.

steps.full_en: At the President of the Schwarzwald Republic's Office (building in north Juno 157, 319), meet Secretary Hes O'Neil (yuno_pre 69 20) O'Neil tells you the President is waiting.
steps.full_ru: В офисе президента Schwarzwald Republic, в здании на севере Juno (157, 319), найдите Secretary Hes O'Neil (yuno_pre 69 20). O'Neil сообщит, что President ждёт.
steps.original_instruction: At the President of the Schwarzwald Republic's Office (building in north Juno 157, 319), meet Secretary Hes O'Neil (yuno_pre 69 20) O'Neil tells you the President is waiting.
steps.short_en: Talk to Secretary Hes O'Neil: yuno_pre 69 20.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Secretary Hes O'Neil: yuno_pre 69 20.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Guard (yuno_pre 95 71) outside the President's office you find out he still meeting with another guest. | You may have to talk to the guard many times to continue
steps.full_ru: У Guard (yuno_pre 95 71) перед кабинетом President узнайте, что тот ещё принимает гостя. Возможно, понадобится поговорить со стражником много раз.
steps.original_instruction: Talk to the Guard (yuno_pre 95 71) outside the President's office you find out he still meeting with another guest. | You may have to talk to the guard many times to continue
steps.short_en: Repeat talks with Guard at yuno_pre 95 71 until the meeting ends.
steps.short_ru: Повторяйте разговор с Guard: yuno_pre 95 71, пока встреча не закончится.

step_actions.condition_text: Repeat until the source event advances; count unknown.

steps.full_en: Finally, a Fine Gentleman comes out of the room; it's Keshnaar. He's the President's guest the Guard talked about!
steps.full_ru: Из комнаты выйдет Fine Gentleman — Keshnaar, гость President, о котором говорил Guard.
steps.original_instruction: Finally, a Fine Gentleman comes out of the room; it's Keshnaar. He's the President's guest the Guard talked about!
steps.short_en: Wait for Keshnaar, the President’s guest, to leave.
steps.short_ru: Дождитесь выхода Keshnaar, гостя President.

steps.full_en: After Keshnaar leaves, ask the Guard about him and you learn that Keshnaar works for Rekenber and is responsible for consulting with the government. You are let into the office.
steps.full_ru: После ухода Keshnaar спросите Guard о нём. Вы узнаете, что Keshnaar работает на Rekenber и консультирует правительство. Вас пропустят в кабинет.
steps.original_instruction: After Keshnaar leaves, ask the Guard about him and you learn that Keshnaar works for Rekenber and is responsible for consulting with the government. You are let into the office.
steps.short_en: After Keshnaar leaves, talk to Guard and enter the office.
steps.short_ru: После ухода Keshnaar поговорите с Guard и войдите в кабинет.

steps.full_en: President Karl (yuno_pre 69 79) is a busy man. So he gives you a few questions to ask him. After he briefs you about it, ask about your mission.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с President Karl (yuno_pre 69 79). Задайте предложенные вопросы, выслушайте объяснения и спросите о задании.
steps.original_instruction: President Karl (yuno_pre 69 79) is a busy man. So he gives you a few questions to ask him. After he briefs you about it, ask about your mission.
steps.short_en: Ask President Karl about the mission: yuno_pre 69 79.
steps.short_ru: Спросите President Karl о задании: yuno_pre 69 79.

steps.full_en: Your first mission from the President is to go to the Aldebran Kafra Headquarters and meet someone called Venice. Before you leave he wants you to pass a file to his Secretary Hes O'Neil. | Obtain File Folder
steps.full_ru: President направит в Aldebran Kafra Headquarters к человеку по имени Venice. Перед уходом он попросит передать файл Secretary Hes O'Neil. Получите File Folder.
steps.original_instruction: Your first mission from the President is to go to the Aldebran Kafra Headquarters and meet someone called Venice. Before you leave he wants you to pass a file to his Secretary Hes O'Neil. | Obtain File Folder
steps.short_en: Receive File Folder from the President for Secretary Hes O'Neil, then head toward Venice.
steps.short_ru: Получите у President File Folder для Secretary Hes O'Neil, затем направляйтесь к Venice.

steps.full_en: As you walk out of the room, you hear someone talking by the window, before the sound fades away.
steps.full_ru: Выходя из комнаты, вы услышите разговор у окна, который вскоре затихнет.
steps.original_instruction: As you walk out of the room, you hear someone talking by the window, before the sound fades away.
steps.short_en: While leaving the room, overhear the conversation by the window.
steps.short_ru: При выходе из комнаты подслушайте разговор у окна.

steps.full_en: Give the File to Hes O'Neil.
steps.full_ru: Передайте File Hes O'Neil.
steps.original_instruction: Give the File to Hes O'Neil.
steps.short_en: Give the File to Hes O'Neil.
steps.short_ru: Передайте File Hes O'Neil.

steps.full_en: Find the Kafra Employee, Benith (aldeba_in 155 240) and she explains about voting rights for Kafra Service & Cool Event Corp.
steps.full_ru: Найдите Kafra Employee, Benith (aldeba_in 155 240). Она объяснит право голоса за Kafra Service & Cool Event Corp.
steps.original_instruction: Find the Kafra Employee, Benith (aldeba_in 155 240) and she explains about voting rights for Kafra Service & Cool Event Corp.
steps.short_en: Talk to Benith: aldeba_in 155 240.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Benith: aldeba_in 155 240.

steps.full_en: After she's done, ask "are you Benith..?" and the let her see the Membership Card. She tells you she's a member of Wind of Secret as well. She explains one of the agent is stuck & is hiding at Grim Reaper's Valley and needs to be rescued. His name is Jargeah.
steps.full_ru: После объяснений спросите «are you Benith..?» и покажите Membership Card. Она расскажет о Wind of Secret и агенте Jargeah, который прячется в Grim Reaper's Valley и нуждается в спасении.
steps.original_instruction: After she's done, ask "are you Benith..?" and the let her see the Membership Card. She tells you she's a member of Wind of Secret as well. She explains one of the agent is stuck & is hiding at Grim Reaper's Valley and needs to be rescued. His name is Jargeah.
steps.short_en: Ask Benith “are you Benith..?” and show Membership Card.
steps.short_ru: Спросите Benith «are you Benith..?» и покажите Membership Card.

steps.full_en: After a long search, I spot A Wounded Man, Jargeah (lhz_fild02 228 214). He asks who you are, so type in Kafra Corporation. He gives you a file and asks you to pass it to Benith and leave him here. | Obtain Sealed File Folder
steps.full_ru: Найдите A Wounded Man, Jargeah (lhz_fild02 228 214). На вопрос, кто вы, введите Kafra Corporation. Он даст файл для Benith и попросит уйти, оставив его здесь. Получите Sealed File Folder.
steps.original_instruction: After a long search, I spot A Wounded Man, Jargeah (lhz_fild02 228 214). He asks who you are, so type in Kafra Corporation. He gives you a file and asks you to pass it to Benith and leave him here. | Obtain Sealed File Folder
steps.short_en: At Jargeah (lhz_fild02 228 214), enter Kafra Corporation; receive Sealed File Folder.
steps.short_ru: У Jargeah (lhz_fild02 228 214) введите Kafra Corporation; получите Sealed File Folder.

steps.full_en: Pass the file to Benith, then she asks about Jargeah. Afterwards, she passes back the file and asks you to hand it over to the President.
steps.full_ru: Передайте файл Benith и расскажите о Jargeah. Она вернёт файл и попросит отнести его President.
steps.original_instruction: Pass the file to Benith, then she asks about Jargeah. Afterwards, she passes back the file and asks you to hand it over to the President.
steps.short_en: Show the file to Benith, then carry it to the President.
steps.short_ru: Покажите файл Benith, затем несите его President.

step_items.condition_text: The same file is returned for onward delivery, not a second independent grant.

steps.full_en: From the file, the President learns that one of the enterprise researchers caried the secret and is hiding in a secret place. His name is Shinokas, and is in Einbroch. My next mission will be find that person. (You may need to wait a few minutes in the room to talk to the President again and be asked about Shinokas) | To continue, you must have completed the Einbroch Murder Quest .
steps.full_ru: Из файла President узнает об исследователе Shinokas, скрывающемся в Einbroch. Он поручит найти его; возможно, потребуется несколько минут ждать в комнате и снова говорить с President. Для продолжения нужно завершить Einbroch Murder Quest.
steps.original_instruction: From the file, the President learns that one of the enterprise researchers caried the secret and is hiding in a secret place. His name is Shinokas, and is in Einbroch. My next mission will be find that person. (You may need to wait a few minutes in the room to talk to the President again and be asked about Shinokas) | To continue, you must have completed the Einbroch Murder Quest .
steps.short_en: Report to the President about the file; complete Einbroch Murder Quest to continue.
steps.short_ru: Доложите President о файле; для продолжения завершите Einbroch Murder Quest.

steps.full_en: When you tell the President about Shinokas, the guard interrupts your conversation and says Hes O'Neil has an urgent matter to see him about. O'Neil passes a pack of documents to President.
steps.full_ru: Когда вы расскажете President о Shinokas, стражник прервёт разговор: Hes O'Neil нужно срочно увидеть President. O'Neil передаст документы.
steps.original_instruction: When you tell the President about Shinokas, the guard interrupts your conversation and says Hes O'Neil has an urgent matter to see him about. O'Neil passes a pack of documents to President.
steps.short_en: Tell the President about Shinokas and wait for documents from Hes O'Neil.
steps.short_ru: Расскажите President о Shinokas и дождитесь документов от Hes O'Neil.

steps.full_en: After President examines the documents, (You may have to click many times), he tells you a secret file about Shinokas is hiding in the store room of Rekenber Headquarters. You are ordered to go somewhere around Lighthalzen to wait for the Kafra Service to contact you.
steps.full_ru: После изучения документов, возможно требующего повторных нажатий, President скажет о тайном файле Shinokas в хранилище Rekenber Headquarters. Идите в район Lighthalzen и ждите связи Kafra Service.
steps.original_instruction: After President examines the documents, (You may have to click many times), he tells you a secret file about Shinokas is hiding in the store room of Rekenber Headquarters. You are ordered to go somewhere around Lighthalzen to wait for the Kafra Service to contact you.
steps.short_en: Get the President’s task for the Shinokas file; go toward Lighthalzen.
steps.short_ru: У President получите задание на файл Shinokas; идите к Lighthalzen.

step_actions.condition_text: Repeat clicks if needed; no fixed count.

steps.full_en: North of Lighthalzen, A Mystery Woman, Esuna appears (lhz_fild01 66 219). She gives you a short briefing on how to infiltrate the corporation and steal the information. Esuna informs you to make contact with a secret agent, Lestin inside the headquarters and obtain a pass from him to disarm the security system. | You should have on a Grandpa Beard and Geek Glasses to gain access to the labs
steps.full_ru: К северу от Lighthalzen появится A Mystery Woman, Esuna (lhz_fild01 66 219). Она объяснит проникновение и направит к агенту Lestin за пропуском, отключающим охрану. Для доступа в лаборатории наденьте Grandpa Beard и Geek Glasses.
steps.original_instruction: North of Lighthalzen, A Mystery Woman, Esuna appears (lhz_fild01 66 219). She gives you a short briefing on how to infiltrate the corporation and steal the information. Esuna informs you to make contact with a secret agent, Lestin inside the headquarters and obtain a pass from him to disarm the security system. | You should have on a Grandpa Beard and Geek Glasses to gain access to the labs
steps.short_en: Talk to Esuna (lhz_fild01 66 219); equip Grandpa Beard and Geek Glasses.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Esuna (lhz_fild01 66 219); наденьте Grandpa Beard и Geek Glasses.

step_items.condition_text: Equip for laboratory access; not consumed.
Equip for laboratory access; not consumed.

steps.full_en: Go back to Lighthalzen, and enter the Rekenber Headquarters. Go past the Guard (lhz_in01 35 226).
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в Lighthalzen и войдите в Rekenber Headquarters. Пройдите мимо Guard (lhz_in01 35 226).
steps.original_instruction: Go back to Lighthalzen, and enter the Rekenber Headquarters. Go past the Guard (lhz_in01 35 226).
steps.short_en: Pass the Guard in Rekenber Headquarters: lhz_in01 35 226.
steps.short_ru: Пройдите Guard в Rekenber Headquarters: lhz_in01 35 226.

steps.full_en: Go to the upper room in the research lab. He is Researcher, Lestin (lhz_in01 285 169). He tells you the location for the file is heavily guarded and the entry pass from him can last for 3 minutes. | Obtain Archive Permit
steps.full_ru: В верхней комнате лаборатории найдите Researcher, Lestin (lhz_in01 285 169). Он расскажет об охраняемом файле и пропуске, действующем 3 минуты. Получите Archive Permit.
steps.original_instruction: Go to the upper room in the research lab. He is Researcher, Lestin (lhz_in01 285 169). He tells you the location for the file is heavily guarded and the entry pass from him can last for 3 minutes. | Obtain Archive Permit
steps.short_en: Receive Archive Permit from Lestin (lhz_in01 285 169); validity is 3 minutes.
steps.short_ru: Получите Archive Permit у Lestin (lhz_in01 285 169); действие — 3 минуты.

steps.full_en: To get to the Document Room, return back outside from where you had to wear the Geek Glasses and Grandpa Beard to enter. Walk past the two female guides and there should be a portal north of them. In the new room, continue walking to the right, past another portal, until you see two guards guarding a room (around lhz_in01 177,29). When you arrive at the corner of the Document Room, wait patiently until both guards leave their post by walking near the (183,29) cell. When prompted, enter the pin number 738495 to enter the room. Then start your infiltrating, slide in the card and input the number on the card and enter the door. (3 minutes before you are spotted)
steps.full_ru: Чтобы попасть в Document Room, выйдите из области, куда входили в Geek Glasses и Grandpa Beard. Пройдите двух проводниц и портал к северу, затем вправо мимо другого портала к двум guards у lhz_in01 177,29. Подойдите к (183,29) и дождитесь, когда оба стражника покинут пост. По запросу введите pin 738495. Затем вставьте карту, введите указанный на ней номер и войдите. До обнаружения есть 3 минуты.
steps.original_instruction: To get to the Document Room, return back outside from where you had to wear the Geek Glasses and Grandpa Beard to enter. Walk past the two female guides and there should be a portal north of them. In the new room, continue walking to the right, past another portal, until you see two guards guarding a room (around lhz_in01 177,29). When you arrive at the corner of the Document Room, wait patiently until both guards leave their post by walking near the (183,29) cell. When prompted, enter the pin number 738495 to enter the room. Then start your infiltrating, slide in the card and input the number on the card and enter the door. (3 minutes before you are spotted)
steps.short_en: At Document Room, wait for the guards to leave; enter 738495, then the number on the card. Limit: 3 minutes.
steps.short_ru: У Document Room дождитесь ухода guards; введите 738495, затем номер с карты. Лимит — 3 минуты.

steps.full_en: Find the document at area 1-5, it's about Heart of Ymir again. It seems like the information you're looking for. | Obtain Shinokas Case File
steps.full_ru: Найдите документ в области 1-5 о Heart of Ymir. Это нужные сведения. Получите Shinokas Case File.

steps.full_en: When President finds out about the death of Shinokas, he says it's not important but the most important thing is what Rekenber is going to do with Ymir's Heart Fragments. He then asks you to run back to Esuna because she might have new information.
steps.full_ru: President узнает о смерти Shinokas, но важнее для него планы Rekenber относительно Ymir's Heart Fragments. Он попросит вернуться к Esuna за новостями.
steps.original_instruction: When President finds out about the death of Shinokas, he says it's not important but the most important thing is what Rekenber is going to do with Ymir's Heart Fragments. He then asks you to run back to Esuna because she might have new information.
steps.short_en: Tell the President about Shinokas and return to Esuna.
steps.short_ru: Расскажите President о Shinokas и вернитесь к Esuna.

steps.full_en: Meet Esuna again. She's very depressed because of the recent losses in her group and they plan to withdraw from Wind Of Secret. She later gives you the file. | Obtain Sealed File Folder
steps.full_ru: Снова встретьтесь с Esuna. Из-за потерь её группа намерена выйти из Wind Of Secret. Она даст файл. Получите Sealed File Folder.

steps.full_en: You now need to investigate the locked down temple until you are able to push through the front gate. For the sake of these directions: | NORTH = Up and left, deeper towards the back of the temple. | EAST = Up and right | WEST = Down and left | SOUTH = Down and right, towards the front of the temple. Follow these directions (or the path shown): | Follow the red path | Blue dots show dialog locations | Once you're inside the locked down temple, head north down the hallway. You will get a popup along the way about some strange noises. | When you reach the end of the hallway, head east. Go up those stairs. | Once upstairs, head north and then east until you find a room with tiled checker flooring. Head towards the back of that room. steps.full_ru: Исследуйте запертый храм, пока не сможете открыть передние ворота. Для этих указаний: NORTH — вверх и влево, в глубину храма; EAST — вверх и вправо; WEST — вниз и влево; SOUTH — вниз и вправо, к передней части. На схеме красная линия показывает путь, синие точки — места диалогов. Войдя, двигайтесь на север по коридору до сообщения о странных звуках. В конце поверните на восток: появится ещё одно сообщение. Из комнаты с женской статуей выйдите через южные ворота. Идите на юг до стены, затем на восток вдоль скамеек в передней части здания. После красного сообщения «CRASH» сразу поверните налево, на север, в коридор с лестницей и поднимитесь. Наверху идите на север, затем на восток, в комнату с шахматным полом; пройдите в её глубину и в портал за статуей. Подойдите к воротам и исследуйте тёмные пятна на полу, двигаясь по следам крови, пока не появится предупреждение уйти, чтобы не стать следующей жертвой. Вернитесь по красному пути к зелёному. Спуститесь по лестнице к юго-западу от комнаты со следами крови. Пройдите немного на восток до Atrium Hallway; остановитесь у статуи у дальней стены. Идите на юг к передней части храма. После сообщения продолжайте на юг к порталу ворот и выберите «Push» или «Kick». Вы окажетесь перед храмом; теперь передние ворота открыты, свет включён и NPC вернулись. Пока не заходите обратно.

branches.full_en: After returning with 10 pages, Abidail will restore one of the four volumes of the report. Keep searching for pages until all the volumes are restored. There is a very high chance that the pages bring do not form a single volume, or that they form a volume you already have. You will lose 10 pages and must collect more. (On iRO, you only lose 5 pages instead) You will automatically fail and discard the pages if he manages to restore a volume of the report you already have on you. As such, you should put completed volumes in storage. The extra volumes of the report can be given to other players doing the quest.
branches.full_ru: Принесите Abidail 10 pages: он попытается восстановить один из четырёх volumes. Продолжайте, пока не восстановите все volumes. Высока вероятность, что pages не образуют том или получится уже имеющийся том. При неудаче теряются 10 pages, а на iRO — только 5 pages. Если восстановлен том, который уже находится у вас, попытка автоматически провалится и pages будут отброшены. Храните готовые volumes на складе; лишние volumes можно передавать другим игрокам, проходящим квест.
branches.short_en: On failure Abidail discards 10 pages; store completed volumes.

steps.full_en: The Linguist isn't able to make any sense of the languages and refers you to the Rune Midgart's Magician.
steps.full_ru: Linguist не сможет разобраться в языках и направит к Rune Midgart's Magician.

steps.short_ru: У Linguist получите направление к Rune Midgart's Magician.

steps.full_en: The Rune Midgart's Magician (mid_camp 147, 256), in the west half of the allied camp, says he needs to actually hear the languages being pronounced. He had some assassins bury gems near the villages to record the spoken languages, he would like you to go retrieve the gems.
steps.full_ru: Rune Midgart's Magician (mid_camp 147, 256) в западной части лагеря нужно услышать произношение. Его ассасины закопали у деревень записывающие самоцветы; он попросит принести их.

steps.short_en: Talk to Rune Midgart's Magician: mid_camp 147, 256; accept the gemstone task.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Rune Midgart's Magician: mid_camp 147, 256; получите задание на самоцветы.

steps.full_en: Talk to the Gem at (spl_fild02 26, 218), near the fairy, and attempt to dig it out. Several thief bugs will spawn, kill them. Repeat until you obtain a Red Jewel from it.
steps.full_ru: Поговорите с Gem (spl_fild02 26, 218) рядом с местом феи и попробуйте выкопать его. Появятся thief bugs — убейте их. Повторяйте, пока не получите Red Jewel.

steps.full_en: Return to the Rune Midgart's Magician with the gemstones, he says he will extract the voices from the gems and send them to the Arunafeltz linguist.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Rune Midgart's Magician с самоцветами. Он извлечёт голоса и отправит записи Arunafeltz linguist.

steps.full_en: Return to the Arunafeltz linguist, He tells you that he has made amazing progress decoding the language. So much so that he's unsure how to even store all the data. He asks you to speak the Schwartzvalt Mechanic.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к Arunafeltz linguist. Он значительно продвинулся в расшифровке, но не знает, где хранить данные, и направит к Schwartzvalt Mechanic.

steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Arunafeltz linguist и вернитесь к Schwartzvalt Mechanic.

steps.full_en: The Schwartzvalt Mechanic says he needs some way to store the massive amount of data, and asks you to inquire with the Rune Midgart's Magician about a magical gem to hold the data.
steps.full_ru: Schwartzvalt Mechanic ищет способ хранить большой объём данных. Он попросит узнать у Rune Midgart's Magician о магическом самоцвете-хранилище.

steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Schwartzvalt Mechanic, затем с Rune Midgart's Magician о хранилище.

steps.full_en: The Rune Midgart's Magician says he needs an Ore unlike any found in the old world to store the data. He asks you to go find one on the manuk fields.

steps.full_en: Return to him with 1 Unidentified Mineral (obtained from "Mysterious Rock" which are located on all 3 Manuk fields). He asks you to wait a minute while he works his magic.
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь к нему с 1 Unidentified Mineral, полученным из Mysterious Rock на всех 3 полях Manuk. Он попросит подождать минуту, пока выполнит магическую работу.

steps.full_en: Talk to the magician and he asks you to take the gem to the Schwartzvalt Mechanic.

steps.full_ru: В конце коридора справа разбейте blue vase в углу (ra_temin 115 140), чтобы отвлечь второго стражника.

steps.full_en: Enter the now unguarded room, and obtain the File Folder from one the drawers. Escape via the ladder.
steps.full_ru: Войдите в комнату, оставшуюся без охраны, и возьмите File Folder из одного из ящиков. Уйдите по лестнице.

steps.full_en: Go to Veins, and enter the building (veins 151,176). Go upstairs and look around, but you can't find the Geologist.
steps.full_ru: В Veins войдите в здание (veins 151,176). Поднимитесь наверх и осмотритесь: Geologist там нет.

steps.full_en: Go to the tavern(veins 153,217), and find the Geologist in the midst of some highly intellectual discussion with his cohorts. Agree to help him, and he makes you his new assistant and gives you Note of Geologist which reads: 1WN, 2ES, 2EC.
steps.full_ru: В таверне (veins 153,217) найдите Geologist, обсуждающего что-то с товарищами. Согласитесь помочь: он назначит вас помощником и выдаст Note of Geologist с записью 1WN, 2ES, 2EC.

steps.short_ru: Согласитесь помочь Geologist в таверне veins 153,217; получите Note of Geologist.

steps.full_en: Return to his room, click the bookshelf for another File Folder (ve_in 280,212) and the wall closet for the Broken Thermometer (ve_in 277,229).
steps.full_ru: Вернитесь в его комнату. Нажмите книжную полку (ve_in 280,212), чтобы получить ещё один File Folder, и настенный шкаф (ve_in 277,229), чтобы получить Broken Thermometer.

steps.full_ru: На Volcano Thor Level 1 нажмите Hot Magma (37, 234). Подойти можно с небольшого расстояния от входа.

steps.full_ru: На Level 2 нажмите точки (165, 37) и (170, 100).

steps.full_ru: Оставаясь на Thor Level 2, войдите в портал (143, 78) и пройдите карту до стражников в конце. Поговорите с ними: они перенесут вас в Base Camp.

steps.full_en: Walk south and talk to Sahedi at (250, 104), and agree to inspect the camp for signs of impending doom.
steps.full_ru: Идите на юг к Sahedi (250, 104) и согласитесь осмотреть лагерь на признаки надвигающейся беды.

steps.full_en: Walk to Colonel Vito(194 220) where you'll be drafted into the anti Rune-Midgard army. (You'll be teleported to the training room to the south part of the map.) | (Be careful when walking around! If you walk when the dialog pops up, you can be disconnected. The map does not allow you to relog there, and you will end up back at your save point).
steps.full_ru: Идите к Colonel Vito (194 220): вас зачислят в армию против Rune-Midgard и перенесут в тренировочную комнату на юге карты. Осторожно: движение при появлении диалога может вызвать отключение. На этой карте нельзя восстановить вход после переподключения, и вы окажетесь на точке сохранения.

steps.short_en: Talk to Colonel Vito (194 220); stop moving when dialogue appears.
steps.short_ru: Поговорите с Colonel Vito (194 220); остановитесь при появлении диалога.

steps.full_en: You'll be asked to give an oath to Colonel Vito, choose Freya then reply to him with the following: | as a devoted servant of Goddess Freya | I pledge my honor to overthrow our mortal enemy | I will show no mercy | I shall devote my entire life | Down with the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Once you complete the oath, speak to him again and he'll send you yo investigate some pipes.
steps.full_ru: Для присяги Colonel Vito выберите Freya, затем ответьте по порядку: as a devoted servant of Goddess Freya | I pledge my honor to overthrow our mortal enemy | I will show no mercy | I shall devote my entire life | Down with the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! После присяги снова поговорите с ним: он направит проверить трубы.

steps.full_en: Talk to the camel, and start collecting the droppings. With the ingredients you collected (the Green Herb, Milk, Jellopy, etc set) you have 5 chances to collect a dropping.
